_source: DragonQuest 3e TSR, Book Two (rules 36-48), estratto da OCR e verificato a campione

colleges.name: Ensorcelments and Enchantments
colleges.requirements: Adepts of the College of Ensorcelments and Enchantments can practice their arts without restriction.
colleges.modifiers: There are no modifiers to the Base Chance of performing any talent, spell, or ritual of the College except as listed in 27.7 or under the descriptions of the specific spells, talents, and rituals of the College.

entries.name: Witchsight
entries.text: The Adept has a Base Chance equal to his Perception +4 per Rank achieved with this talent of seeing objects or entities that are normally invisible or that have been rendered invisible by magical means (i.e., such spells as Walking Unseen, Blending, and Invisibility). The Experience Point Multiple for this talent is 150.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept ha una Base Chance pari alla sua Percezione +4 per Rank raggiunto con questo talento di vedere oggetti o entità normalmente invisibili o resi invisibili con la magia (ad esempio con incantesimi come Cammino invisibile, Mimetismo e Invisibilità). Il Moltiplicatore XP di questo talento è 150.

entries.name: Spell of Charming
entries.effects: The effects of this spell are identical to those for the spell of that name (S-1, p.44) of the College of Naming Incantations except that the target's Generic True Name need not be known to cast the spell. If the Generic True Name is known, the Base Chance is increased by 15. If the Individual True Name is known and used, the Base Chance is increased by 25.
entries.testo_it: Gli effetti sono identici a quelli dell'incantesimo omonimo (S-1) del Collegio degli Incantesimi dei Nomi, con la differenza che per lanciarlo non serve conoscere il Vero Nome generico del bersaglio. Se il Vero Nome generico è noto, la Base Chance aumenta di 15; se il Vero Nome individuale è noto e viene pronunciato, aumenta di 25.

entries.name: Spell of Telekinesis
entries.effects: The effects of this spell are identical to those for the spell of that name (5-9, p. 41) of the College of Sorceries of the Mind.
entries.note: Base Chance come Stregonerie della Mente S-9.
entries.testo_it: Gli effetti sono identici a quelli dell'incantesimo omonimo (S-9) del Collegio delle Stregonerie della Mente.

entries.name: Spell of Enchanted Sleep
entries.effects: The Adept can send 1 entity that normally spends any time sleeping into a deep enchanted sleep that will last for the duration of the spell or until the entity is wakened by another entity (by being shaken, etc.). The target cannot be wakened if the spell is Rank 10 or higher, but must continue to sleep until the spell wears off.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept fa cadere in un profondo sonno incantato un'entità che normalmente dorme. Il sonno dura quanto l'incantesimo, o finché un'altra entità non sveglia il bersaglio (scuotendolo, ecc.). Dal Rank 10 in su il bersaglio non può essere svegliato e dorme fino alla fine dell'incantesimo.

entries.name: Spell of Walking Unseen
entries.effects: Identical to the spell of that name (G-5, p53) of the College of Earth Magics. [30.1] BACKFIRE TABLE Dice Backfire Result 01-10 How unfortunate! Not only do you fail to cast the spell, but your Fatigue is reduced by a number equal to the Fatigue already expended in the attempt. 41-17 Worse yet! You fail to cast the spell, and your Fatigue is reduced by a number of points equal to twice the Fatigue already expended in the atternpt. 18-22, For shame! You should be grateful that your teachers cannot see you in your hour of degradation. Not only do you fail to cast the spell, but your Fatigue is reduced by a number of points equal to three times the Fatigue already expended in the attempt. 23-24 This is simply not your day. You fail to cast the spell and you must reduce your Fatigue by a number equal to four times the number of points already expended in the attempt. 25 Magic may not be your calling. You might consider a future in animal husbandry instead. You have failed to cast your spell and your Fatigue is reduced by a number of points equal to five times the Fatigue already expended in the attempt 26-35 Your spell has reversed itself and is presently taking full affect on your own person instead of on the intended target. 36-45 Once again your spell has reversed itself as in result 26-35. However, this time, in addition to the effects of the reversal, your Fatigue is reduced by a number of points equal to the Fatigue expended in attempting to cast the spell. 46-50 Your companions may well curse your name for this! The GM assigns a number to each character within Range and rolls D10. The character whose number is first rolled is the target of the spell. If no character's number is rolled, the GM rolls again until one character’s number is rolled. 51-55 A result similar to 46-50 except that the spell’s effect is doubled (GM choosing what attribute of the spell will be doubled). 56-60 Your spell takes effect, but only at half Backfire Result strength. The GM determines what characteristic is to be halved and does so (rounding down). Dice 61 You are cursed with total blindness lasting D10 weeks. 62 You are cursed with total blindness lasting a number of weeks equal to two times D10. 63 You are cursed with total blindness lasting a number of weeks equal to three times D10. 64 You are cursed with total deafness lasting a number of weeks equal to the result of a D10 die roll. 65 You are cursed with total deafness lasting a number of weeks equal to two times D10. 66 You are cursed with total deafness lasting a number of weeks equal to three times D110. 67 You are cursed with being totally mute for a number of weeks equal to the result of D10 die roll. 68 You are cursed with being totally mute for a number of weeks equal to two times D10. 69 You are cursed with being totally mute fora number of weeks equal to three times D10. 70 You are cursed with insomnia and nightmares and may only regain half Fatigue (rounded up) during sleep periods for D10 weeks, 71 You are cursed with insomnia and nightmares and may only regain half Fatigue {rounded up) during sleep periods for a number of weeks equal to two Himes D10. mares and may only regain half Fatigue (rounded up) during sleep periods for a number of weeks equal to three times DIO. 73-75 You are cursed with a virulent skin disease which will cause you intense pain and make you hideous to look upon. The disease will reduce your Physical Beauty by 10 and your Willpower by 3 until cured by magic or the arts of a healer. Once cured, the disease Backfire Result will still reduce your Physical Beauty by 1 for each full week during which it affected you. This reduction is a permanent result of scarring. 76-80 You are cursed with periodic muscle spasms of random occurrence and unpredictable duration which tend to leave you limp and exhausted. The spasms will persist until you are cured by magic or the arts of a Rank 2 healer. Reduce Dexterity by 5 and Endurance by half (round down) until you have been cured. Dice 81-85 You begin to suffer from intense and regularly recurring migraines which reduce your Willpower by 1 and your Magical Aptitude by 3 until you are cured of your affliction either by magic or the arts of a Rank 2 healer. 86-90 You become arthritic and enfeebled and will remain so until cured by magic or the arts of a Rank 3 healer. Reduce your Fatigue by half (round down) and subtract 4 from Dexterity and 3 from Agility until cured. 91-95 You have become subject to creeping senility which will last until cured by magic (only) and which will become worse as time goes on. Your Magical Aptitude is immediately reduced by 2 and is reduced by an additional 2 at the beginning of each week until cured. Once cured of your affliction, you will have to relearn any spells forgotten during the period of your illness. All spell attempts made during the illness will have their Base Chance of taking effect reduced by 10. 96-100 You are cursed with total amnesia and lose all skills, ranks and magical abilities for a period equal to one day times D10. During this time, you may not cast spells, use special skills or talents or use a weapon except in its unranked state. Your friends will have to care for you since your surroundings are totally unfamiliar and your survival defenses will have been quite effectively short-circuited. You will willingly take their orders and advice, but you would just as willingly follow an ogre into his cave if he asked you.
entries.testo_it: Identico all'incantesimo omonimo (G-5) del Collegio delle Magie della Terra.

entries.name: Spell of Speaking to Enchanted Creatures
entries.effects: The spell gives the Adept the ability to speak and understand the language of all magical creatures.
entries.nome: Incantesimo di Parola con le creature incantate
entries.testo_it: L'incantesimo dà all'Adept la capacità di parlare e capire la lingua di tutte le creature magiche.

entries.name: Spell of Location
entries.effects: The Adept can determine the direction in which he will find any person or object of his desire that he has previously encountered or studied and that is within range. The direction will be indicated by a large glowing arrow.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept può determinare la direzione in cui troverà qualunque persona o oggetto desideri, purché l'abbia già incontrato o studiato e si trovi entro la portata. La direzione viene indicata da una grande freccia luminosa.

entries.name: Spell of Mass Charming
entries.effects: Charms 1 entity per Rank as long as the Adept maintains his concentration. The spell takes 3 minutes to take effect and the effects linger 3 to 5 minutes after concentration is broken. The effects are identical to S-1, p. 44 of the College of Naming Incantations.
entries.testo_it: Ammalia 1 entità per Rank finché l'Adept mantiene la concentrazione. L'incantesimo impiega 3 minuti a fare effetto e gli effetti persistono da 3 a 5 minuti dopo che la concentrazione si interrompe. Gli effetti sono identici a S-1 del Collegio degli Incantesimi dei Nomi.

entries.name: Spell of Invisibility
entries.effects: At Ranks 1 through 15, the target becomes invisible, but cannot initiate an attack (by making a Strike Check) without first becoming visible again. At Ranks 16 and up, the target can attack while invisible. The target can always choose to become visible again at any time while the spell is in effect. Once he chooses to become visible, he cannot again become invisible as a result of the effects of that spell. A new Spell of Invisibility can be cast over him.
entries.testo_it: Dal Rank 1 al 15 il bersaglio diventa invisibile, ma non può iniziare un attacco (con uno Strike Check) senza prima tornare visibile. Dal Rank 16 in su può attaccare restando invisibile. Il bersaglio può sempre scegliere di tornare visibile mentre l'incantesimo è attivo; una volta tornato visibile, non può ridiventare invisibile con lo stesso incantesimo. Gli si può lanciare addosso un nuovo Incantesimo di Invisibilità.

entries.name: Blight Spell
entries.effects: Any target who fails to resist has his Strike Chance and his Magic Resistance reduced by 1 per Rank (minimum of 1). This is also called the “evil eye” spell.
entries.testo_it: Il bersaglio che non resiste vede ridotte la Strike Chance e la Magic Resistance di 1 per Rank (minimo 1). È detto anche incantesimo del "malocchio".

entries.name: Ritual of Enchantment
entries.text: The Adept can enchant any entity of his choice who is in his physical presence during the ritual. The Adept cannot enchant himself. The ritual takes 1 hour and requires that the Adept first draw a protective circle within which both he and the object of the ritual must remain during the entire ritual. The Adept can perform no other actions while implementing this ritual. The Base Chance of the ritual being successful is 80% plus 1 per Rank. The effects last a fortnight at Ranks 1 through 10, 3 months at Ranks 11 through 19, and until dispelled at Rank 20. The Experience Multiple for this spell is 125. It requires that the Adept burn 1 ounce of black myrrh at a cost of 100 Silver Pennies or the ritual will be ineffective. The target of this ritual will be either blessed or cursed (caster's choice) with an increase or decrease in the target's Base Chance of doing anything or suffering any good or ill fortune by plus or minus 1 per Rank. All Strike Chances, Resistance checks, etc., directly affecting the target will continue to be altered in this manner until] the effects of the ritual wear off. If the ritual is used to curse, the curse is minor.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept può incantare qualunque entità a sua scelta presente fisicamente durante il rituale; non può incantare se stesso. Il rituale dura 1 ora e richiede che l'Adept tracci prima un cerchio protettivo, dentro cui lui e il soggetto devono restare per tutto il tempo, senza compiere altre azioni. La Base Chance di successo è 80% più 1 per Rank. Gli effetti durano due settimane dal Rank 1 al 10, 3 mesi dall'11 al 19 e fino a essere dissolti al Rank 20. Il Moltiplicatore XP è 125. Bisogna bruciare un'oncia di mirra nera, del costo di 100 monete d'argento, altrimenti il rituale non ha effetto. Il soggetto viene benedetto o maledetto (a scelta dell'Adept): la sua Base Chance di fare qualunque cosa o di subire buona o cattiva sorte aumenta o diminuisce di 1 per Rank. Strike Chance, prove di resistenza e simili che lo riguardano direttamente restano modificate finché il rituale non svanisce. Se usato per maledire, la maledizione è minore.

entries.name: Ritual of Creating Crystal of Vision
entries.text: The Adept can create a crystal that acts in the same manner as a Waters of Vision Spell {S-8, p. 49) of the College of Water Magics. To do so, the Adept must remain in the same place and take no other action. He performs the ritual over an available piece of crystal (the bigger the crystal, the better the image will ultimately be) in his possession. The Base Chance of creating the Crystal of Vision is 30% +3 per Rank. The Experience Multiple is 500. The Adept must burn 1 ounce of ambergris during the ritual at a cost of 1,000 Silver Pennies. The resulting crystal can be used once per day for 10 minutes +2 minutes per Rank (GM's should carefully time consultations) in the same manner as the Waters of Vision. The Ritual takes 10 hours.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept crea un cristallo che funziona come l'Incantesimo delle Acque della visione (S-8) del Collegio delle Magie dell'Acqua. Deve restare fermo senza fare altro, eseguendo il rituale su un pezzo di cristallo in suo possesso (più grande è il cristallo, migliore sarà l'immagine). La Base Chance è 30% +3 per Rank; il Moltiplicatore XP è 500. Durante il rituale bisogna bruciare un'oncia d'ambra grigia, del costo di 1.000 monete d'argento. Il cristallo si può usare una volta al giorno per 10 minuti +2 minuti per Rank, come le Acque della visione. Il rituale dura 10 ore.

entries.name: Ritual of Creating Sleep Dust
entries.text: The Adept must spend 3 hours preparing and implementing this ritual and must expend 10,000 Silver Pennies (-500 per Rank) to purchase the necessary ingredients prior to making the attempt. If the attempt fails, the ingredients are ruined and can not be reused or resold. The Base Chance of success is 80% +1 per Rank. If the ritual succeeds, one ounce (a single dose) of sleep dust results. When thrown in the face of one target it has the effect of an instant Spell of Enchanted Sleep of the same Rank as the sleep dust. The sleep dust will only remain fresh for three weeks after manufacture. The Experience Multiple for this ritual is 250. Note: The effects of sleep dust can be passively resisted by the victim, but with a reduction of 20 to his Magic Resistance.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept deve impiegare 3 ore per preparare ed eseguire il rituale e spendere 10.000 monete d'argento (-500 per Rank) per gli ingredienti. Se il tentativo fallisce gli ingredienti sono rovinati e non si possono riutilizzare né rivendere. La Base Chance è 80% +1 per Rank. Se riesce, si ottiene un'oncia (una dose) di polvere del sonno: lanciata in faccia a un bersaglio ha l'effetto immediato di un Incantesimo del Sonno incantato dello stesso Rank. La polvere resta efficace per tre settimane. Il Moltiplicatore XP è 250. La vittima può resistere passivamente, ma con -20 alla Magic Resistance.

entries.name: Ritual of Manufacturing Poison Dust
entries.text: This ritual works in the same manner as Q-3 and employs the same numbers for all purposes. However, instead of causing the victim to fall asleep, it inflicts D -5 (+1 for every 2 or fraction of 2 Ranks) damage due to poisoning on individuals who fail to resist. Like sleep dust, poison dust must be thrown in the face of the target.
entries.testo_it: Funziona come Q-3 e usa gli stessi valori. Invece di addormentare, però, infligge D10-5 (+1 ogni 2 Rank o frazione) danni da avvelenamento a chi non resiste. Come la polvere del sonno, va lanciata in faccia al bersaglio.

entries.name: Ventriloquism Spell
entries.effects: The spell allows the Adept to project his voice and alter it so that it sounds like any other voice the Adept has heard. The voice can be projected so that it appears to be emanating from anywhere within the radius of the spell.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept proietta la propria voce e la altera perché somigli a qualunque altra voce abbia sentito. La voce può sembrare provenire da qualsiasi punto entro il raggio dell'incantesimo.

entries.name: Bolt of Energy Spell
entries.effects: The Adept can cast a bolt of energy at a target and will, as a result, inflict (D-5) +1 per Rank damage on the first person or object through which the bolt passes.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept scaglia un dardo di energia contro un bersaglio e infligge (D10-5) +1 per Rank danni alla prima persona o al primo oggetto che il dardo attraversa.

entries.name: Spell of Opening
entries.range: 15 feet +15 feet for every 2 or fraction of 2
entries.effects: Instantly opens locks, bolts, and doors, including those locked by the Mage Lock Spell (5-6).
entries.testo_it: Apre all'istante serrature, chiavistelli e porte, comprese quelle chiuse con l'Incantesimo della Serratura magica (S-6).
entries.portata_it: 15 piedi (+15 piedi ogni 2 Rank o frazione)

entries.name: Spell of Enchanting Weapons
entries.duration: 20 seconds X (D -5) X Rank (1, if unranked)
entries.effects: Increases the Base Chance to hit with the weapon over which it is cast by 1 + an additional 1 per Rank and increases the damage done by the weapon by 1 for every 3 or fraction of 3 Ranks.
entries.note: Il manuale non riporta la Base Chance.
entries.testo_it: Aumenta la Base Chance di colpire con l'arma su cui è lanciato di 1 +1 per Rank e il danno dell'arma di 1 ogni 3 Rank o frazione.
entries.durata_it: 20 secondi x (D10-5) x Rank (x1 senza Rank)

entries.name: Web of Entanglement Spell
entries.effects: This spell works similarly to the Web of Fire Spell (S-4, p. 50) of the College of Fire Magics except that it allows the Adept to project a sticky web instead of a web of fire from his fingertips. Any objects or individuals immediately between the caster and the target of the spell (along the flight path of the web) will be stuck by the web and ensnared. The web can ensnare a number of human-sized targets equal to the Rank of the spell. Ensnared characters cannot move, and can only take actions in every other pulse. In order to free himself from the web, each ensnared character's player must roll his character's Physical Strength or less on D100 or successfully cut the web. The web is cut whenever any Strike against it with a weapon that is rated for type B damage results in 10 or more Damage Points to the web. Once any character cuts the web, all characters cease to be ensnared by it.
entries.testo_it: Funziona come l'Incantesimo della Rete di fuoco (S-4) delle Magie del Fuoco, ma l'Adept proietta dalle dita una ragnatela appiccicosa invece che di fuoco. Oggetti e persone tra l'Adept e il bersaglio (lungo il percorso della ragnatela) vi restano invischiati. La ragnatela può intrappolare tanti bersagli di taglia umana quanto il Rank dell'incantesimo. Chi è intrappolato non può muoversi e agisce solo un Pulse sì e uno no. Per liberarsi bisogna tirare con D100 un risultato pari o inferiore alla propria Forza fisica, oppure tagliare la ragnatela: un colpo con un'arma di Classe B che le infligga 10 o più danni la taglia, e a quel punto tutti sono liberi.

entries.name: Mage Lock Spell
entries.duration: 1 hour+1 additional per Rank (until dispelled at Rank 20)
entries.effects: The spell can be cast over any portal (door, window, etc.) that can normally be opened or closed. It effectively locks the portal with an unpickable lock. The portal can still be forced open by brute strength. The Physical Strength(s) of all characters attempting to force a portal locked in this manner are added together and multiplied by the Difficulty Factor of the task. The Difficulty Factor is always a function of the Rank of the spell: Rank Difficulty 1-5, 2 6-10 1 11-20 ie)
entries.testo_it: Si lancia su qualunque apertura che si possa aprire e chiudere (porta, finestra, ecc.) e la chiude con una serratura impossibile da scassinare. L'apertura può ancora essere forzata con la forza bruta: si sommano le Forze fisiche di chi ci prova e si moltiplicano per il fattore di difficoltà, che dipende dal Rank: Rank 1-5 fattore 2, Rank 6-10 fattore 1, Rank 11-20 fattore 0,5.
entries.durata_it: 1 ora (+1 per Rank); al Rank 20 finché non viene dissolto

entries.name: Spell of Enhancing Enchantment
entries.effects: The Rank of this spell is added to one characteristic of any spell being cast within range unless the caster of the subject spell successfully resists. Only range, duration, base chance, or (where appropriate) damage can be affected by this spell.
entries.testo_it: Il Rank di questo incantesimo si aggiunge a una caratteristica di qualunque incantesimo lanciato entro la portata, a meno che chi lo lancia non resista. Si possono modificare solo portata, durata, Base Chance o (quando c'è) danno.

entries.name: Spell of Levitation
entries.effects: Causes the target of the spell to rise into the air 15 feet +1 additional foot per Rank at the rate of 2 feet every 10 seconds. The spell is limited to vertical movement and will in no way propel the target horizontally.
entries.testo_it: Il bersaglio si solleva in aria di 15 piedi +1 piede per Rank, alla velocità di 2 piedi ogni 10 secondi. Il movimento è solo verticale: l'incantesimo non sposta il bersaglio in orizzontale.
entries.durata_it: 10 minuti x (D10-5) x Rank (x1 senza Rank)

entries.name: Spell of Enchanting Armor
entries.effects: Subtracts 2 per Rank from the Strike Chance of any character attempting to hit the target with a physical weapon. At Rank 11 and above it also permits the character's armor to absorb 1 additional point of damage. This spell can be cast on one target only and the target must be armored.
entries.testo_it: Sottrae 2 per Rank alla Strike Chance di chiunque cerchi di colpire il bersaglio con un'arma fisica. Dal Rank 11 l'armatura del bersaglio assorbe anche 1 danno in più. Si lancia su un solo bersaglio, che deve indossare un'armatura.

entries.name: Wizard's Eye Spell
entries.effects: The Adept creates an invisible, intangible eye that he can move about within a radius equal to the spell’s range. The eye originates in the same spot as the Adept and operates as would any normal eye except that it is not attached to the Adept physically.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept crea un occhio invisibile e intangibile che può muovere entro un raggio pari alla portata. L'occhio parte dalla posizione dell'Adept e funziona come un occhio normale, ma non è fisicamente attaccato a lui.

entries.name: Spell of Slowness
entries.duration: 10 seconds X (D - 5) X Rank (1, if unranked)
entries.effects: The spell affects 1 target plus 1 additional target per 2 or fraction of 2 Ranks. All entities subject to this spell have their running, crawling, flying, or swimming speed halved and have the time it takes them to do anything on the Tactical Display doubled (e.g., they could only attack once every two Pulses).
entries.testo_it: Colpisce 1 bersaglio più 1 ogni 2 Rank o frazione. Chi ne è colpito dimezza la velocità di corsa, strisciamento, volo o nuoto, e impiega il doppio del tempo per qualunque cosa sul Tactical Display (ad esempio attacca solo una volta ogni due Pulse).
entries.durata_it: 10 secondi x (D10-5) x Rank (x1 senza Rank)

entries.name: Spell of Quickness
entries.duration: 10 seconds X (D-5) X Rank (1, if unranked)
entries.effects: The spell affects 1 target plus 1 additional target per 3 or fraction of 3 Ranks. The target’s TMR is doubled, his Initiative Value is increased by 10, and he can perform Actions twice as fast.
entries.testo_it: Colpisce 1 bersaglio più 1 ogni 3 Rank o frazione. Il TMR del bersaglio raddoppia, il suo Initiative Value aumenta di 10 e compie le azioni al doppio della velocità.
entries.durata_it: 10 secondi x (D10-5) x Rank (x1 senza Rank)

colleges.name: Sorceries of the Mind
colleges.requirements: Adepts of the College of Sorceries of the Mind can practice their arts without restriction.
colleges.modifiers: The following numbers are added to the Base Chance of performing any talent, spell, or ritual of the College of Sorceries of the Mind. Each point Adept's Willpower is greater than target's Willpower 1 Each point Adept’s Willpower is less than target's Willpower -2 All modifiers are cumulative.

entries.name: Resist Temperature
entries.text: Adepts of this College suffer 1 (+1 for each 5 or fraction of 5 Ranks) less Damage Points from either heat or cold (or fire or ice) used as weapons. They are immune to extremes of temperature. The Experience Multiple for the Talent is 250.
entries.testo_it: Gli Adept di questo Collegio subiscono 1 danno in meno (+1 ogni 5 Rank o frazione) da caldo o freddo (o fuoco o ghiaccio) usati come armi, e sono immuni alle temperature estreme. Il Moltiplicatore XP del talento è 250.

entries.name: Resist Pain
entries.text: Adepts of this College are more or less immune to pain. They cannot be stunned and are immune to the Assassin interrogation ability. In addition, if there is a chance that their concentration may have been broken, 5 (+1 per Rank) is always added to the Base Chance of their maintaining the concentration despite intrusions. Their concentration is never automatically broken (i-e., is never broken without a check to see if they maintain concentration). The Experience Multiple for this Talent is 300.
entries.testo_it: Gli Adept di questo Collegio sono quasi immuni al dolore: non possono essere storditi e sono immuni all'interrogatorio dell'Assassino. Quando la loro concentrazione rischia di interrompersi, aggiungono sempre 5 (+1 per Rank) alla probabilità di mantenerla, e la loro concentrazione non si interrompe mai automaticamente senza una prova. Il Moltiplicatore XP del talento è 300.

entries.name: Sensitivity to Danger
entries.text: Adepts of this College always add 5 (+1 per Rank) to their chances of detecting an ambush (see 84.2). The Experience Multiple for this Talent is 300.
entries.testo_it: Gli Adept di questo Collegio aggiungono sempre 5 (+1 per Rank) alla probabilità di scoprire un'imboscata (84.2). Il Moltiplicatore XP del talento è 300.

entries.name: Spell of Extrasensory Perception
entries.effects: The Adept can sense the presence and general mood (but not the exact nature) of any entity within range of the spell.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept percepisce la presenza e lo stato d'animo generale (ma non la natura esatta) di qualunque entità entro la portata.

entries.name: Spell of Limited Precognition
entries.effects: The Adept can see (unclearly) into the future a number of hours equal to 1 (+1 per Rank) and can ascertain events that may or may not be important to him.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept vede, in modo confuso, nel futuro per 1 ora (+1 per Rank) e può intuire eventi che potrebbero riguardarlo o meno.

entries.name: Mind Cloak Spell
entries.range: Can only be cast over self.
entries.effects: The Adept cloaks his own mind so that his thoughts cannot be detected or “read.” The Adept's Resistance versus Mental Attack (S-1) is increased by 10+2 additional per Rank while the spell is in effect.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept avvolge la propria mente in modo che i suoi pensieri non possano essere percepiti o letti. Finché l'incantesimo dura, la sua resistenza all'Attacco mentale (S-1) aumenta di 10 +2 per Rank.

entries.name: Spell of Empathy
entries.effects: The spell allows the Adept to feel the emotions and physical sensations the target of the spell is currently experiencing. It also allows the Adept to absorb wounds from Endurance and Fatigue at a rate of 2 points cured for every 1 that the Adept agrees to subtract from his own Fatigue (never Endurance). Thus, an Adept could remove 6 Damage Points from a character by inflicting 3 of the 6 on himself (the other 3 being eliminated). At Rank 10 or higher, the Adept can cast this spell on characters who are 15 feet {+ 15 additional feet per Rank above 10) or less from him.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept sente le emozioni e le sensazioni fisiche che il bersaglio prova in quel momento. Può anche assorbirne le ferite alla Resistenza e alla Fatica: ne cura 2 per ogni punto che accetta di togliere alla propria Fatica (mai alla Resistenza). Così può togliere 6 danni a un personaggio infliggendone 3 a se stesso. Dal Rank 10 può lanciarlo su personaggi a 15 piedi o meno (+15 piedi per ogni Rank oltre il 10).

entries.name: Spell of Hypnotism
entries.effects: The Adept can lull an entity of his choice that is within range into a trance-like state in which he will be subject to suggestion. The spell can only be cast over a target with whom the caster is normally able to communicate verbally, It cannot be cast over a totally hostile character. Once the subject has been hypnotized, the Adept can make suggestions that the subject will readily accept unless they conflict directly with his best interests. The subject will remain suggestable so long as concentration is maintained and will continue to implement suggestions for 3 (+3 additional per Rank) hours after the suggestion has been made, even when no longer hypnotized. The subject will never have any idea where the suggestions it is implementing came from.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept porta un'entità a sua scelta, entro la portata, in uno stato di trance in cui è suggestionabile. Funziona solo su un bersaglio con cui l'Adept può normalmente comunicare a voce, e non su un personaggio del tutto ostile. Una volta ipnotizzato, il soggetto accetta i suggerimenti dell'Adept, purché non siano direttamente contrari ai suoi interessi. Resta suggestionabile finché l'Adept mantiene la concentrazione e continua a eseguire i suggerimenti per 3 ore (+3 per Rank) dopo averli ricevuti, anche quando non è più ipnotizzato. Non saprà mai da dove vengono.

entries.name: Spell of Controlling Animals
entries.effects: The Adept gains control over the every action of one animal within range. If he releases the animal or his concentration is broken it may attack him.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept controlla ogni azione di un animale entro la portata. Se lo lascia libero o perde la concentrazione, l'animale può attaccarlo.

entries.name: Spell of Controlling Person
entries.effects: The Adept gains control of the every action of one person within range. He can control the physical activities of that person (but cannot cause him to cast spells). The subject always acts as if he was also affected by a Spell of Slowness (Ensorcelments and Enchantments, 5-11). The spell continues in effect until the Adept’s concentration is broken or he releases the victim.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept controlla ogni azione di una persona entro la portata: ne guida le attività fisiche ma non può farle lanciare incantesimi. Il soggetto agisce sempre come se fosse sotto un Incantesimo di Lentezza (Incantamenti, S-11). L'effetto dura finché l'Adept non perde la concentrazione o non libera la vittima.

entries.name: Ritual of Binding Will
entries.text: The Adept can employ this ritual in order to bind the will of 1 entity that is physically present and either unconscious or otherwise restrained. The ritual takes 1 hour to perform and lasts for 1 day +1 additional day per Rank, It has a Base Chance of 10 (plus 5 per Rank) and an Experience Multiple of 500. The Adept can perform no other action while sngaged in the performance of this ritual. Once sound, the subject will remain bound until the fects of the ritual wear off or he breaks the psychic bounds restraining him. The subject gets a chance to passively resist once during the performance of the ritual and once at the end of each day. If he successfully resists, the bonds are broken and he is free. Until that time, he will be the loyal retainer of the Adept and serve him in all things. The Adept cannot release the subject from servitude voluntarily, and the magic continues to work even after the Adept is dead (the subject will dispose of the body and take the deceased's personal effects to his widow/widower). If the ritual backfires, the Adept loses D10 from his Willpower; hypnotism (G-5) cast by another Adept immediately cures this loss,
entries.testo_it: Con questo rituale l'Adept vincola la volontà di un'entità fisicamente presente e svenuta o immobilizzata. Il rituale dura 1 ora e l'effetto 1 giorno +1 giorno per Rank. La Base Chance è 10 (più 5 per Rank) e il Moltiplicatore XP è 500. Durante il rituale l'Adept non può fare altro. Il soggetto resta vincolato finché il rituale non svanisce o finché non spezza i legami psichici: può resistere passivamente una volta durante il rituale e una volta alla fine di ogni giorno, e se ci riesce è libero. Fino ad allora è il servitore fedele dell'Adept in tutto. L'Adept non può liberarlo di sua volontà e la magia continua anche dopo la sua morte (il servitore si occuperà del corpo e porterà gli effetti personali alla vedova o al vedovo). Se il rituale ha un contraccolpo, l'Adept perde D10 punti di Volontà; un'Ipnosi (G-5) lanciata da un altro Adept cura subito la perdita.

entries.name: Spell of Mental Attack
entries.effects: The Adept can cast this spell at any character within range who can be seen or whose position has been pinpointed via Telepathy (S-2). If the target fails to resist a successful spellcast, he falls unconscious. In addition, at Ranks of 15 and above he loses (D5) (minimum of 1) from Willpower. This loss from Willpower can be cured via hypnotism (G-5) only (once hypnotised, the subject is totally cured),
entries.testo_it: L'Adept può lanciarlo su qualunque personaggio entro la portata che possa vedere o di cui abbia individuato la posizione con la Telepatia (S-2). Se il bersaglio non resiste perde i sensi. Dal Rank 15 perde anche D5 punti di Volontà (minimo 1), che si recuperano solo con l'Ipnosi (G-5): una volta ipnotizzato, il soggetto guarisce del tutto.

entries.name: Spell of Telepathy
entries.range: 30 feet +30 additional per The entity is pinpointed whenever his thoughts are read.
entries.effects: The spell gives the Adept the ability to completely read the every thought of all entities within
entries.testo_it: L'Adept può leggere completamente ogni pensiero di tutte le entità entro la portata.

entries.name: Phantasm Spell
entries.effects: The spell conjures a beast with an Endurance and Fatigue with a combined value of 20 (+5 additional points for each 3 Ranks). The creature is a physical entity that must be targeted at a particular victim. It will then track the victim down and attack him until either the victim is killed or the phantasm is dispelled (using a counterspell}. The phantasm always hits for (D -4)+1 additional point per Rank damage. It need not make a Strike Check when it hits. The phantasm is invisible to all but the victim.
entries.testo_it: L'incantesimo evoca una bestia con Resistenza e Fatica che sommate valgono 20 (+5 ogni 3 Rank). È un'entità fisica che va diretta contro una vittima precisa: la rintraccia e la attacca finché la vittima non muore o il fantasma non viene dissolto con un controincantesimo. Il fantasma colpisce sempre, senza Strike Check, infliggendo (D10-4) +1 per Rank danni. È invisibile a tutti tranne che alla vittima.

entries.name: Spell of Molecular Disruption
entries.resist_text: Can be passively resisted (then suffers half damage).
entries.effects: Spell causes cellular damage to any living being or being in corporeal (substantial rather than insubstantial) form, doing (D+1)+1 additional points per Rank damage to any single target that fails to resist and half damage (round up) to any target that successfully resists.
entries.testo_it: Provoca danni cellulari a qualunque essere vivente o in forma corporea, infliggendo (D10+1) +1 per Rank danni a un singolo bersaglio che non resiste, e metà dei danni (per eccesso) a chi resiste.
entries.resistenza_it: Resistenza passiva (chi resiste subisce metà danno)

entries.name: Spell of Molecular Rearrangement
entries.effects: The Adept can rearrange the cells of any object that fails to resist, turning it into anything of the same mass that he desires.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept riordina le cellule di qualunque oggetto che non resista, trasformandolo in ciò che desidera purché della stessa massa.

entries.name: Force Shield Spell
entries.effects: Reduces the Base Chance of the Adept being hit by 5% (+1% additional per Rank).
entries.testo_it: Riduce del 5% (+1% per Rank) la Base Chance di colpire l'Adept.

entries.name: Spell of Healing
entries.effects: The Adept can heal the subject of 2 (+1 per Rank) Damage Points that have been removed from the subject’s Fatigue or Endurance.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept cura al soggetto 2 (+1 per Rank) danni subiti alla Fatica o alla Resistenza.

entries.name: Spell of Invisibility
entries.effects: The Adept can cause the target of this spell to become impossible to sense in any fashion unless the observer's Player rolls his Perception or less on D100.
entries.testo_it: Il bersaglio diventa impossibile da percepire in qualunque modo, a meno che l'osservatore non ottenga con D100 un risultato pari o inferiore alla propria Percezione.

entries.name: Spell of Telekinesis
entries.effects: Allows the Adept to lift 2 pounds and move it at the rate of one mile an hour. The Adept can move an additional 5 pounds or move the chosen mass at an additional 2 miles an hour per Rank.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept solleva 2 libbre e le muove alla velocità di un miglio all'ora. Per ogni Rank può muovere 5 libbre in più o aumentare la velocità di 2 miglia all'ora.

entries.name: Spell of Telekinetic Rage
entries.duration: Concentration/maximum of 60 seconds + 10 additional per Rank
entries.effects: The Adept creates a storm of force emanating from him that hurls any object or character away from him at bone-breaking speed out of the range of the spell. Any character who fails to resist suffers (D -5) +1 per foot travelled damage.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept scatena una tempesta di forza che parte da lui e scaglia lontano, oltre la portata dell'incantesimo, oggetti e personaggi a una velocità da spezzare le ossa. Chi non resiste subisce (D10-5) +1 danno per ogni piede percorso.

entries.name: Ritual of Binding Elements
entries.text: The Adept can bind any element (Earth, Air, Fire or Water) as if he were performing the binding ritual for the College dealing with that element. The ritual is conducted in exactly the same manner as the specific ritual for binding the element the Adept is attempting to bind, but the Base Chance is only 1%. In addition, the Experience Multiple is 600. In all other ways the binding is executed according to the rules governing the appropriate ritual of binding from the College concerned with the element being bound.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept può vincolare un elemento qualsiasi (Terra, Aria, Fuoco o Acqua) come se eseguisse il rituale di vincolo del Collegio di quell'elemento. Il rituale si svolge esattamente come quello specifico, ma la Base Chance è solo 1% e il Moltiplicatore XP è 600. Per il resto valgono le regole del rituale di vincolo del Collegio corrispondente.

colleges.name: Illusions
colleges.requirements: Adepts of the College of Illusions can practice their arts without restriction.
colleges.modifiers: The following numbers are added to the Base Chance of performing any talent, spell or ritual of the College of lilusions: For each sense above 1 affected by an illusion -5 For each point the Adept’'s Will- power is above 15 2 For each point the Adept’s Will- power is below 15 -2

entries.name: Witchsight
entries.text: TheAdept-has-a-Base-Ghanceequal to his Perception (+5 per Rank achieved with this talent) of seeing objects that are normally invisible or that have been rendered invisible by magical means (i.e., such spells as Walking Unseen, Blending, and Invisibility). The Adept also possesses the night-vision of an Elf. The Experience Multiple for this Talent is 200.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept ha una Base Chance pari alla sua Percezione (+5 per Rank) di vedere oggetti normalmente invisibili o resi invisibili con la magia (ad esempio con Cammino invisibile, Mimetismo e Invisibilità). Ha anche la visione notturna di un Elfo. Il Moltiplicatore XP del talento è 200.

entries.name: Projected Image
entries.text: The Adept can, by remaining stationary and concentrating for the duration of the talent's workings, project an image of himself standing within 15 feet (+15 additional feet per Rank) of his actual position. While he continues to concentrate, the illusion of himself will remain and his actual person will be invisible. Once he breaks his concentration, he will become visible and the illusion will fade. It takes about 10 seconds minus 1 second per Rank for the image to form and the Adept to become invisible. The Experience Multiple for this Talent is 150.
entries.testo_it: Restando immobile e concentrato per tutta la durata del talento, l'Adept proietta un'immagine di sé entro 15 piedi (+15 piedi per Rank) dalla sua vera posizione. Finché si concentra, l'illusione resta e lui è invisibile; quando smette, torna visibile e l'immagine svanisce. L'immagine si forma e l'Adept diventa invisibile in circa 10 secondi meno 1 secondo per Rank. Il Moltiplicatore XP del talento è 150.

entries.name: Flash of Light Spell
entries.effects: Unlike other spells of this College, this spell is no illusion at all. Instead, the Adept expends 2 Fatigue Points, (in addition to the other Fatigue Point costs for the spell) to create a blinding flash of light. All entities who are facing the Adept when the spell is loosed must either resist or be blinded for 20 seconds. Blinded characters have their Base Chance of Striking reduced by 50 and they can move at half their normal Tactical Movement Rate. The Adept is unaffected by the spell since it emanates from his own body.
entries.testo_it: A differenza degli altri incantesimi del Collegio, non è un'illusione: l'Adept spende 2 punti di Fatica in più del normale per creare un lampo di luce accecante. Tutte le entità rivolte verso l'Adept quando l'incantesimo viene lanciato devono resistere o restano accecate per 20 secondi. Chi è accecato ha -50 alla Base Chance di colpire e si muove a metà del TMR. L'Adept non ne è colpito, perché il lampo parte dal suo corpo.

entries.name: Visual Illusion Spell
entries.resist_text: Must be disbelieved instead of resisted.
entries.effects: This spell creates a visual illusion that will be fully as mobile as the object or entity it represents and will seem to have all of the characteristics of the object or entity. However, if it touches or is touched by another entity or object, it will immediately fade.
entries.testo_it: Crea un'illusione visiva, mobile quanto l'oggetto o l'entità che rappresenta e con tutte le sue caratteristiche apparenti. Se tocca o viene toccata da un'altra entità o oggetto, svanisce all'istante.
entries.resistenza_it: Si deve non credere invece di resistere

entries.name: Audio Illusion Spell
entries.resist_text: Must be disbelieved instead of resisted.
entries.effects: This spell creates the illusion of sound or sounds of the Adept's choice.
entries.testo_it: Crea l'illusione di uno o più suoni a scelta dell'Adept.
entries.resistenza_it: Si deve non credere invece di resistere

entries.name: Olfactory Illusion Spell
entries.resist_text: Must be disbelieved instead of resisted.
entries.effects: Creates a smell (and/or taste) of the Adept's choice.
entries.testo_it: Crea un odore (e/o un sapore) a scelta dell'Adept.
entries.resistenza_it: Si deve non credere invece di resistere

entries.name: Tactile Illusion Spell
entries.resist_text: Must be disbelieved instead of resisted.
entries.effects: This spell creates a tactile illusion of the Adept's choice. It can also be used to cause 1 targett+1 additional target for every 3 (or fraction) Ranks to experience physical sensations of hunger, pain, wellbeing, etc. Unless such sensations can be attributed by the target to some outside stimulus other than the Adept, the illusion cannot harm the victim. All damage inflicted on a victim by an illusion remains once the illusion is disbelieved. It is real (not illusory) damage.
entries.testo_it: Crea un'illusione tattile a scelta dell'Adept. Può anche far provare a 1 bersaglio (+1 ogni 3 Rank o frazione) sensazioni fisiche come fame, dolore o benessere. Se il bersaglio non può attribuirle a una causa esterna diversa dall'Adept, l'illusione non può fargli del male. I danni inflitti da un'illusione restano anche dopo che la vittima smette di crederci: sono danni reali.
entries.resistenza_it: Si deve non credere invece di resistere

entries.name: Ritual of Illusory Fog
entries.text: The Adept can, by spending one hour in the performance of this ritual, create the illusion of fog or mist in an area within 30 feet +30 additional feet per Rank of the Adept. The fog or mist will last so long as the Adept concentrates on maintaining it and it is not dispelled by magic. The ritual has a Base Chance of 50% (+5 per Rank) and an Experience Multiple of 50.
entries.testo_it: Con un'ora di rituale l'Adept crea l'illusione di nebbia o foschia in un'area entro 30 piedi (+30 piedi per Rank) da sé. La nebbia dura finché l'Adept si concentra per mantenerla e non viene dissolta dalla magia. La Base Chance è 50% (+5 per Rank) e il Moltiplicatore XP è 50.

colleges.name: Naming Incantations
colleges.modifiers: The following numbers are added to the Base Chance of performing any talent, spell or ritual of the College of Naming Incantations: Namer has never before encountered target's generic type 25 Namer does not know (has not learned) target's Generic True Name -15 Each Rank Namer has achieved with Generic True Name of object or non- sentient being 2 Each Rank Namer has achieved with Individual True Name of sentient being 7 These additions to the Base Chance are cumulative and are tacked onto the Base Chance in addition to those modifiers listed in 27.7, Note that both Rank with a particular spell or ritual and Rank in the use of the Name of the target both affect the Base Chance.

entries.name: Ritual of Dissipation
entries.text: This ritual allows the Namer to use any counterspell he presently knows to dissipate (remove) the effects of a spell cast over an individual or object. The ritual is treated the same as Ritual Spell Preparation (see 32.1) except that the Namer concludes by casting the appropriate counterspell to dissipate the target spell. In order to perform this ritual, the Namer must know the exact name of the spell that was cast over the character or object, what College the spell was a part of, and whether or not the spell was a General or Special Knowledge spell. Only Namers can use counterspells to dissipate spells once they have been cast. Generally, only spells (not rituals) can be dissipated using this technique. Summoned entities, however, whether summoned by spell or ritual, can be banished using this ritual. This is the only instance in which a successful ritual can be be undone in this manner. NOTE: Adepts of other Colleges can use counterspells to send entities that they have personally summoned back to their own dimension. In such cases, the counterspell is not cast as part of a ritual. Only Namers can dispel magic by using this ritual. At least 1 hour must be spent implementing the ritual; the Namer cannot simply cast a counterspell over a character or object to achieve the same effect-(see-31.3). The Namer. cannot achieve Rank with this ritual, though the specific counterspell used may be Ranked.
entries.testo_it: Il rituale permette al Namer di usare un controincantesimo che conosce per dissolvere gli effetti di un incantesimo lanciato su una persona o un oggetto. Si svolge come la Preparazione rituale (32.1), ma si conclude lanciando il controincantesimo adatto. Il Namer deve conoscere il nome esatto dell'incantesimo, il suo Collegio e se è di Conoscenza generale o speciale. Solo i Namer possono dissolvere così incantesimi già lanciati, e in genere solo incantesimi, non rituali; le entità evocate, però, con incantesimo o rituale, possono essere rimandate indietro con questo rituale. Gli Adept degli altri Collegi possono comunque rimandare nella loro dimensione le entità evocate personalmente con un controincantesimo, senza rituale. Il rituale richiede almeno 1 ora; il Namer non può ottenere lo stesso effetto lanciando semplicemente un controincantesimo (31.3). Non si ottiene Rank con questo rituale, ma il controincantesimo usato può averlo.

entries.name: Spell of Charming
entries.effects: The Namer can influence the actions of any one entity whose Generic True Name he knows by casting a Spell of Charming over the individual. If, in addition, the Namer knows and pronounces the victim's Individual True Name, the Base Chance of the spell taking effect is increased by 50 and the effect of the spell is increased. The victim of the spell will see the caster as his true friend and will readily accept most suggestions emanating from him. Sworn enemies of the caster (or of his race) will not be affected by this spell unless the victim's Individual True Name is spoken and, even then, the duration of the spell is halved. The caster can either suggest actions to the victim or can order him to act in a certain way on pain of losing the caster's “friendship.” Any suggestion that is not directly and obviously inimical to the victim's interests (as defined by the GM, but usually limited to actions that would be injurious or fatal to the victim) will be acted upon 90% of the time. The caster can only insure 100% compliance with a request by making it an order based upon the friendship that binds the victim and caster together. In such instances, however, the victim immediately makes a Resistance Check. If he resists, the spell is broken and he is immediately freed (and will probably attack the caster in a rage). Otherwise, the victim will accept the order and 100% faithful to it for the remainder of the spell. Whenever any suggestion is made that would lead to the victim's injury or death, another Resistance Check is made. If the check is unsuccessful, the victim will accept the suggestion. Otherwise, the spell will be broken and he will (probably) attack the caster.
entries.testo_it: Il Namer influenza le azioni di un'entità di cui conosce il Vero Nome generico. Se conosce e pronuncia anche il Vero Nome individuale, la Base Chance aumenta di 50 e l'effetto è più forte. La vittima vede l'Adept come un vero amico e accetta volentieri quasi tutti i suoi suggerimenti. I nemici giurati dell'Adept (o della sua razza) non ne sono colpiti se non si pronuncia il loro Vero Nome individuale, e anche allora la durata si dimezza. L'Adept può suggerire azioni o dare ordini minacciando di ritirare la sua amicizia. Un suggerimento non apertamente contrario agli interessi della vittima (di solito, non dannoso o mortale per lei) viene eseguito nel 90% dei casi. Per avere obbedienza totale l'Adept deve trasformarlo in un ordine fondato sull'amicizia: la vittima fa subito una prova di resistenza; se resiste l'incantesimo si spezza (e probabilmente attacca l'Adept infuriata), altrimenti obbedisce fedelmente per il resto della durata. Ogni suggerimento che porterebbe la vittima a ferirsi o morire richiede un'altra prova di resistenza: se fallisce lo accetta, altrimenti l'incantesimo si spezza.

entries.name: Spell of Compelling Obedience
entries.effects: The Namer can cast this spell over any target(s) whose Generic or Individual True Names are known to him. Once successfully cast, the spell permits the caster to order the target to do anything within its physical capabilities that is not obviously suicidal. The spell ‘ can affect a number of targets equal to or less than the caster’s Rank with this spell. No target can resist an order once it has failed to initially resist the spell. The Base Chance is increased by 25 if the caster pronounces the Individual True Name of all the spell’s targets.
entries.testo_it: Il Namer lancia l'incantesimo su bersagli di cui conosce il Vero Nome generico o individuale. Se riesce, può ordinare al bersaglio qualunque cosa sia fisicamente in grado di fare e non sia palesemente suicida. Può colpire un numero di bersagli pari o inferiore al Rank. Chi non ha resistito all'incantesimo non può poi rifiutare gli ordini. La Base Chance aumenta di 25 se l'Adept pronuncia il Vero Nome individuale di tutti i bersagli.

entries.name: Ritual of Magic Divination
entries.text: -- Namer can’determine if-an individual or object is currently or has been recently under the effects of a spell by employing the Ritual of Magic Divination. The object or individual must be present during the ritual, which lasts for 1 hour. At the end of the ritual, the Namer's player makes a Cast Check to determine if the ritual has had the desired effect. The Base Chance for this check is 40%. The
entries.testo_it: Con il Rituale di Divinazione magica il Namer scopre se una persona o un oggetto è, o è stato di recente, sotto l'effetto di un incantesimo. Il soggetto deve essere presente durante il rituale, che dura 1 ora. Alla fine si fa un Cast Check con Base Chance 40%.

colleges.name: Air Magics
colleges.requirements: Adepts of the College of Air Magics can only practice their arts if they are in contact with air. They cannot practice air magic while underwater or ina vacuum. They cannot sum- mon creatures of the air into an environment where avians could not survive.
colleges.modifiers: The following numbers are added to the Base Chance of performing any talent, spell, or ritual of the College of Air Magics: Caster occupies a mountain top 20 Caster is underground or otherwise totally enclosed* -15 Caster is only partially enclosed? -5 *TJotal enclosure is defined as being sur- rounded by walls or earth in a windowless area where there is no direct and immediate com- munication with the air outside. +Partial enclosure is defined as being ina cave or dwelling or similar walled or earth- enclosed area, but being in sight of a window or means of egress or other means of direct contact with the air outside. All modifiers are cumulative.

entries.name: Predict Weather
entries.text: The Adept predicts with some accuracy what the weather will be like over the ensuing three days in the area within range of his talent. The talent operates effectively within a radius of 10 miles of the adept {+10 additional miles per Rank). The adept's player announces that he is checking the weather (sniffing the air and such) and then rolls D100. If the result is equal to or less than the adept’s modified Perception, he is successful in making a prediction. In addition to other modifiers affecting the operation of his talent, the player adds 5 for each Rank he has achieved with the talent. If the adept is successful in making a prediction, the GM secretly rolls D100 to check the accuracy of the prediction. The following results can occur: Dice Accuracy 01-05 ‘Totally wrong (opposite of the prediction occurs) 06-10 Generally incorrect (fairly wide divergence) 11-85 Generally correct (close, but not totally accurate) 86-100 Almost totally accurate (say, within 1 degree) Following this dice roll, the GM delivers the prediction arrived at by the character as if it were generally correct. The working of the talent cannot be resisted. It has an Experience Multiple of 150.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept prevede con una certa precisione il tempo dei tre giorni successivi entro 10 miglia (+10 miglia per Rank). Il giocatore annuncia che sta osservando il tempo (annusa l'aria e così via) e tira D100: se ottiene la Percezione modificata o meno, la previsione riesce; al tiro si aggiunge 5 per ogni Rank del talento. Se riesce, il GM tira in segreto D100 per l'accuratezza: 01-05 del tutto sbagliata (accade l'opposto); 06-10 per lo più errata; 11-85 per lo più corretta; 86-100 quasi perfetta. Il GM comunica comunque la previsione come se fosse corretta. Il talento non può essere contrastato; il Moltiplicatore XP è 150.

entries.name: Spell of Resistance to Cold
entries.effects: The target of this spell gains 2 per Rank to its Magic Resistance for purposes of resisting a spell that damages via cold. In addition, 1 is subtracted from the damage done by any fire damage spell for every 2 Ranks.
entries.testo_it: Il bersaglio ottiene +2 per Rank alla Magic Resistance contro gli incantesimi che danneggiano con il freddo. Inoltre i danni degli incantesimi di fuoco si riducono di 1 ogni 2 Rank.
entries.durata_it: 10 minuti x (D10-5) x Rank (x1 senza Rank)

entries.name: Spell of Ice Creation
entries.duration: Rank X6 minutes (6 minutes, if unranked)
entries.effects: The spell creates a film of ice 1 inch thick and equal to one square foot per Rank or a cube of ice at the rate of 6 cubic inches per Rank.
entries.testo_it: Crea uno strato di ghiaccio spesso un pollice e largo un piede quadrato per Rank, oppure un cubo di ghiaccio di 6 pollici cubi per Rank.
entries.durata_it: Rank x 6 minuti (6 minuti senza Rank)

entries.name: Spell of Mage Wind
entries.effects: The Adept can summon a wind strong enough to power a longship at the rate of 5 knots (+1 additional knot per Rank), unless the ship is Facing into the wind. If facing into the wind, the speed of the prevailing wind is subtracted from the ship's speed in knots (the rate at which it is propelled by the Mage Wind). The Adept can freely alter the direction of the Mage Wind during the spell.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept evoca un vento capace di spingere una nave lunga a 5 nodi (+1 nodo per Rank), se la nave non procede controvento; in quel caso si sottrae la velocità del vento dominante. L'Adept può cambiare liberamente la direzione del vento finché dura l'incantesimo.
entries.durata_it: 5 minuti x D10 x Rank (x1 senza Rank)

entries.name: Spell of Communication With Avians
entries.effects: Gives the Adept the power to communicate with any flying creatures within range of the spell.
entries.nome: Incantesimo di Comunicazione con gli uccelli
entries.testo_it: L'Adept può comunicare con qualunque creatura volante entro la portata.

entries.name: Wind Whistle Spell
entries.effects: The Adept is able to create a wind of up to 30 knots over the area he occupies. The wind will take D-2 minutes to arrive and the Adept's Player must state before that time what direction the wind is blowing. The actual velocity of the wind is determined by rolling D100: Dice Velocity 01-10 20 knots 11-25 10 knots 26-50 3 knots §1-75 10 knots 76-90 20 knots 91-100 30 knots The Adept can add or subtract (his choice) a number equal to his Rank from the dice roll used to determine velocity. He need not announce his intention to do so until after he has rolled the dice and ascertained the result,
entries.testo_it: L'Adept crea sopra di sé un vento fino a 30 nodi. Il vento arriva in D10-2 minuti e il giocatore deve dichiararne prima la direzione. La velocità si tira con D100: 01-10 20 nodi; 11-25 10 nodi; 26-50 3 nodi; 51-75 10 nodi; 76-90 20 nodi; 91-100 30 nodi. L'Adept può aggiungere o togliere al tiro un numero pari al proprio Rank, anche dopo averlo visto.

entries.name: Spell of Conjuring Mist
entries.effects: The Adept creates a 10-foot cubic volume of mist or fog. He can add an additional 10-foot cube per Rank to this volume. However, all the fog must fall within the Adept’s range. It can be of any shape and can be moved by the Adept so long as it is all within range. Subtract 1 from the Base Chance for each knot of wind currently blowing.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept crea un cubo di nebbia o foschia di 10 piedi di lato, più un altro cubo di 10 piedi per Rank. Tutta la nebbia deve restare entro la portata; può avere qualunque forma e l'Adept può spostarla, sempre entro la portata. Si sottrae 1 alla Base Chance per ogni nodo di vento.
entries.durata_it: 1 minuto x D10 x Rank (x1 senza Rank)

entries.name: Spell of Summoning Avians
entries.effects: The Adept can summon one flying entity (other than a dragon) per Rank (minimum of 1). The avian must be native to the area and the Adept must state the species he is calling (one per spell) before attempting the spell. The avians will appear 5 minutes (-30 seconds per Rank) after the spell has been cast. This spell requires that the Adept’s player actually whistle to call the desired flying creatures. If he can't whistle (or if his character is notin a position to vocalize), he cannot cast the spell.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept richiama una creatura volante (non un drago) per Rank (minimo 1). Deve essere originaria della zona e l'Adept deve dichiararne la specie (una per incantesimo) prima di lanciare. Gli uccelli arrivano dopo 5 minuti (-30 secondi per Rank). Per lanciarlo il giocatore deve fischiare davvero; se non sa fischiare (o il personaggio non può emettere suoni) l'incantesimo non si può lanciare.

entries.name: Spell of Detecting Fumes
entries.effects: The Adept can detect the presence of fumes or vapors and has a 25% chance (+2 per Rank) of identifying them.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept percepisce la presenza di fumi o vapori e ha il 25% (+2 per Rank) di identificarli.

entries.name: Ritual of Windspeak
entries.text: The Adept can speak with the whispering spirits of the wind, learning what they have seen or heard and even soliciting their aid. All winds within a range of 300 feet + an additional 300 feet per Rank can be communed within this manner. The Adept must spend one hour performing this ritual and cannot move or engage in any other activity during that time. The Base Chance that the ritual will be effective is equal to the Adept's Magical Aptitude +5 for each Rank the Adept has achieved. The ritual has an Experience Multiple of 150, and there is no backfire.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept parla con gli spiriti sussurranti del vento, scopre ciò che hanno visto e sentito e può persino chiederne l'aiuto. Può comunicare con tutti i venti entro 300 piedi (+300 piedi per Rank). Il rituale dura un'ora, durante la quale l'Adept non può muoversi né fare altro. La Base Chance è pari all'Attitudine magica +5 per Rank. Il Moltiplicatore XP è 150 e non ci sono contraccolpi.

entries.name: Ritual of Binding Air
entries.text: The Adept can bind the element of air within a radius of 10 feet +10 additional feet per Rank for a period equal to 1 hour (+1 additional hour per Rank) while maintaining his concentration. It takes an hour to perform the ritual, which has a Base Chance equal to the Adept's Magical Aptitude (+4 per Rank). It cannot be resisted unless the area contains an already extant Air Elemental (who can both actively and passively resist), The results of the ritual are similar to those for the binding of other elements. The Adept gains control of all of the facets of the element. He can control the weather, shape the winds, even create an Air Elemental similar to the Fire Elemental described in 42.5. The Experience Multiple for this ritual is 750, and if it backfires, a violent storm results.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept vincola l'elemento aria entro 10 piedi (+10 piedi per Rank) per 1 ora (+1 ora per Rank), mantenendo la concentrazione. Il rituale dura un'ora e ha Base Chance pari all'Attitudine magica (+4 per Rank). Non si può resistere, a meno che nell'area non ci sia già un Elementale dell'aria (che può resistere attivamente e passivamente). L'Adept controlla ogni aspetto dell'elemento: il tempo, la forma dei venti, persino la creazione di un Elementale dell'aria simile a quello del fuoco (42.5). Il Moltiplicatore XP è 750; un contraccolpo scatena una violenta tempesta.

entries.name: Windstorm Spell
entries.effects: The Adept creates a windstorm within an area with a radius of 30 feet +30 additional feet per Rank. All characters within this area except the Adept must either resist or suffer D--6(+1 for every 2 Ranks) damage and must check to determine if they remain standing. Each character's Player rolls D100. If the result is less than or equal to the sum of the character's Physical Strength and Agility minus the Rank of this spell, the character remains standing. Otherwise, the character falls prone.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept scatena una tempesta di vento in un raggio di 30 piedi (+30 piedi per Rank). Tutti i personaggi nell'area tranne l'Adept devono resistere o subire D10-6 (+1 ogni 2 Rank) danni, e devono controllare se restano in piedi: con D100 pari o inferiore a Forza fisica + Agilità meno il Rank dell'incantesimo restano in piedi, altrimenti cadono a terra.

entries.name: Spell of Storm Calling
entries.effects: The Adept can summon any storm front that may exist anywhere in sight. Upon reaching the spot occupied by the Adept, the storm front will slow and finally cease moving and begin to downpour (snow, rain, hail, sleet, or whatever else the GM feels the clouds may contain). Generally, a storm front can be seen for 20 to 30 miles. If no front can be seen, the spell can still be cast, but the Base Chance is reduced by 20. The stormfront will take D103 (-1 per Rank) minutes to arrive.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept richiama un fronte temporalesco visibile all'orizzonte. Giunto sopra l'Adept, il fronte rallenta, si ferma e scarica la sua pioggia (neve, grandine, nevischio o altro). Di solito un fronte si vede a 20-30 miglia. Se non se ne vede nessuno l'incantesimo si può lanciare comunque, ma con -20 alla Base Chance. Il fronte arriva in D10+3 minuti (-1 per Rank).

entries.name: Spell of Ice Construction
entries.effects: The Adept can create 10 cubic feet of ice (+10 additional cubic feet per Rank) in any shape(s) of the Adept's choice. The objects always appear entirely within range of the Adept and cannot appear on top of or inside (partially or wholly) any character or entity.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept crea 10 piedi cubi di ghiaccio (+10 per Rank) nelle forme che preferisce. Gli oggetti compaiono sempre interamente entro la portata e non possono apparire sopra o dentro un personaggio o un'entità.

entries.name: Spell of Controlling Avians
entries.duration: Concentration/maximum of 1 hour + additional per Rank
entries.effects: The Adept can control 1 avian (+1 additional avian per Rank) within range unless the avian successfully resists. If the Adept fails to gain control or loses control, the avian will immediately attack him and his companions.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept controlla 1 creatura volante (+1 per Rank) entro la portata, a meno che non resista. Se l'Adept non riesce a prenderne il controllo o lo perde, la creatura attacca subito lui e i suoi compagni.

entries.name: Spell of Freezing Wind
entries.effects: The spell causes arctic conditions to prevail in a 10 foot cube. The area can be increased by 1 foot {all dimensions) per Rank, Any character in this area (including the Adept) must resist or take D -4 (+1 per Rank) damage due to freezing. Increase the Base Chance of infection (see 24) as a result of damage from this spell by 30. If a creature of fire (efreet, salamander or elemental) is caught within the effective area of the spell, the creature takes D--1 (+1 per Rank) damage.
entries.testo_it: Crea condizioni artiche in un cubo di 10 piedi, ampliabile di 1 piede per lato per Rank. Chiunque si trovi nell'area (Adept compreso) deve resistere o subire D10-4 (+1 per Rank) danni da congelamento, con +30 alla probabilità di infezione. Le creature del fuoco (efreet, salamandre, elementali) nell'area subiscono D10-1 (+1 per Rank) danni.

entries.name: Spell of Ice Projectiles
entries.effects: The spell attacks one target within range per Rank (minimum of 1). If the target fails to resist, he suffers D-3 (+1 per Rank) damage due to being pierced by type-A weapons made of ice. In addition, his chance of infection is increased by 10 as a result of any wound from ice projectiles.
entries.testo_it: L'incantesimo colpisce un bersaglio per Rank (minimo 1) entro la portata. Chi non resiste subisce D10-3 (+1 per Rank) danni, trafitto da proiettili di ghiaccio di Classe A. Ogni ferita da ghiaccio aumenta di 10 la probabilità di infezione.

entries.name: Lightning Spell
entries.resist_text: Can only passively resist (then suffers half damage).
entries.effects: The Adept can throw a single bolt of lightning 60 feet long from his fingertips. The bolt must extend the entire 60 feet and will rebound any feet not travelled initially. Any target that is in the path of the bolt must successfully resist or suffer D +5 damage +1 additional point for every 3 or fraction Ranks (and become automatically stunned).
entries.testo_it: L'Adept scaglia dalle dita un fulmine lungo 60 piedi. Il fulmine percorre sempre tutti i 60 piedi e rimbalza per la parte che non ha percorso. Chiunque si trovi sul suo percorso deve resistere o subire D10+5 danni +1 ogni 3 Rank o frazione, restando automaticamente stordito.
entries.resistenza_it: Solo resistenza passiva (chi resiste subisce metà danno)

entries.name: Spell of Hibernation
entries.range: Can only be cast over self or adjacent character
entries.resist_text: Can be actively or passively resisted.
entries.effects: The Adept can cause himself or one other character to enter a state of suspended animation lasting for the following periods (dependent upon Rank): Rank Duration 1-3 1 week 4-8 1 month 9-11 3 months 12-16 6 months 17-19 1 year 20 Any duration of the adept's choice The target of the spell will awaken when the spell is over with no ill effects except that his Physical Strength will be reduced by D-6 due to muscle atrophy. This reduction is temporary and the character can regain his previous Physical Strength at the rate of 1 point per day. Physical Strength cannot be reduced below 1.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept fa entrare se stesso o un altro personaggio in animazione sospesa per un periodo che dipende dal Rank: 1-3 una settimana; 4-8 un mese; 9-11 tre mesi; 12-16 sei mesi; 17-19 un anno; 20 qualunque durata a scelta dell'Adept. Alla fine il bersaglio si sveglia senza danni, salvo una perdita di D10-6 punti di Forza fisica per l'atrofia muscolare, che recupera al ritmo di un punto al giorno (la Forza fisica non scende sotto 1).
entries.portata_it: Solo su se stessi o su un personaggio adiacente

entries.name: Weapon of Cold Spell
entries.effects: The weapon over which the spell is cast becomes infernally cold without harm either to the weapon or the user of it. The Base Chance of hitting the weapon is increased by 1 and by an additional 1 for each Rank the Adept has acquired with the spell. The damage done by the weapon is increased by 1 for every 3 Ranks (or fraction of 3) the Adept has acquired with the spell. The damage is increased by 1 per Rank (instead of for every 3 Ranks) if used against a Fire character.
entries.testo_it: L'arma su cui è lanciato diventa gelida senza danneggiare né l'arma né chi la impugna. La Base Chance di colpire aumenta di 1 +1 per Rank e il danno di 1 ogni 3 Rank o frazione; contro un personaggio del fuoco il danno aumenta invece di 1 per Rank.
entries.durata_it: 20 secondi x (D10-5) x Rank (x1 senza Rank)

entries.name: Barrier of Wind Spell
entries.range: Can only be cast over self.
entries.effects: The spell forms a barrier of wind around the Adept that decreases the Strike Chance of any attacker in Melee Combat by 5 (+1 for each Rank). Hurled weapons and missile weapons have their Strike Chance reduced by an additional 2 per Rank (instead of 1).
entries.testo_it: Crea attorno all'Adept una barriera di vento che riduce di 5 (+1 per Rank) la Strike Chance di chi lo attacca in mischia. Contro armi da lancio e da tiro la riduzione è di 2 per Rank invece di 1.

entries.name: Snow Simulacrum Spell
entries.range: Caster must shape object and touch it to cast spell.
entries.effects: The caster must form a human or animal figure out of snow. This sculpture can then be animated by the spell. The animated sculpture will have the same characteristics as the sculptured entity except that all characteristics are reduced 25%. Although no longer composed of snow, the simulacrum will have an adverse reaction to the presence of heat and flame and will take an additional 2 points damage from heat and flame attacks. The time required to actually build the sculpture will depend upon the size of the entity being sculpted and must be determined by the GM.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept modella con la neve una figura umana o animale e la anima con l'incantesimo. Il simulacro ha le caratteristiche dell'essere raffigurato ridotte del 25%. Anche se non è più fatto di neve, teme calore e fiamme e subisce 2 danni in più dagli attacchi di fuoco e calore. Il tempo per costruire la scultura dipende dalle sue dimensioni ed è stabilito dal GM.
entries.portata_it: L'incantatore deve modellare l'oggetto e toccarlo

entries.name: Wall of Ice Spell
entries.effects: The Adept can create a wall 2 feet thick, 10 feet tall and 20 feet long or a ring 2 feet thick, 10 feet tall and with a 5 foot radius or a pillar 15 feet high and 4 feet thick made of ice. He can increase any dimension by 1 foot per Rank. This spell can not be cast on top of characters.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept crea un muro di ghiaccio spesso 2 piedi, alto 10 e lungo 20, oppure un anello spesso 2 piedi, alto 10 e con raggio di 5, oppure una colonna alta 15 piedi e spessa 4. Ogni dimensione aumenta di 1 piede per Rank. Non si può creare sopra i personaggi.

entries.name: Ray of Cold Spell
entries.resist_text: Can only passively resist (then suffers half damage).
entries.effects: The spell projects a ray of frozen air at a target. Anything standing between the caster and the target blocks the ray. Anything struck by the ray (target or another character or object) must either resist or suffer D-1 (+1 per Rank) points of damage due to freezing. If a character successfully resists, the damage is halved (round up). Regardless of whether full or half damage is suffered, the Base Chance of infection increases by 20.
entries.testo_it: Proietta un raggio d'aria gelata contro un bersaglio; qualunque cosa si trovi in mezzo lo blocca. Chi viene colpito (il bersaglio o un altro) deve resistere o subire D10-1 (+1 per Rank) danni da congelamento; se resiste, il danno si dimezza (per eccesso). In ogni caso la probabilità di infezione aumenta di 20.
entries.resistenza_it: Solo resistenza passiva (chi resiste subisce metà danno)

entries.name: Spell of Sleep Gas
entries.effects: The spell creates a cloud of knockout gas 20-foot cube ( +10-foot additional cube per Rank) in size anywhere entirely within the Adept's range. Any character (including the Adept) inhaling the gas must successfully resist or suffer D-3 (+1 additional point per Rank) damage. In addition, a second check must be made against each character's Endurance. All characters whose Players roll a D100 result higher than their modified Endurance immediately fall unconscious. A character must check to determine if he falls unconscious even if he passes his initial Resistance Check.
entries.testo_it: Crea una nube di gas soporifero di 20 piedi cubi (+10 per Rank), interamente entro la portata. Chi la respira (Adept compreso) deve resistere o subire D10-3 (+1 per Rank) danni. Inoltre ognuno tira D100 contro la propria Resistenza modificata: chi supera il valore perde i sensi, anche se ha superato la prima prova di resistenza.

entries.name: Spell of Windwalking
entries.effects: The Adept can propel a chosen target through the air at 120 miles per hour.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept spinge in volo un bersaglio a sua scelta a 120 miglia all'ora.

entries.name: Whirlwind Vortex Spell
entries.effects: Creates a whirlwind around one human-sized target for every 3 Ranks (minimum of 1) or fraction of 3 Ranks. If the targets fail to resist, they perish (are torn apart by the winds}. If the spell is cast, but a target’s passive resistance is successful, the target suffers D -4 (+1 per Rank) damage instead of perishing.
entries.testo_it: Crea un vortice attorno a un bersaglio di taglia umana ogni 3 Rank o frazione (minimo 1). Chi non resiste muore, fatto a pezzi dai venti; chi resiste passivamente subisce invece D10-4 (+1 per Rank) danni.

entries.name: Spell of Frozen Doom
entries.effects: Turns the blood of one target entity to ice. This spell is ineffective against targets whose modified Magic Resistance is greater than the modified chance of casting the spell (though the spell could still backfire),
entries.testo_it: Trasforma in ghiaccio il sangue di un bersaglio. Non funziona sui bersagli la cui Magic Resistance modificata supera la probabilità di lancio modificata (anche se l'incantesimo può comunque avere un contraccolpo).

entries.name: Ritual of Controlling Weather
entries.text: The Adept can gather storm clouds, increase or decrease the temperature by 5° (+1 additional degree per Rank), increase or decrease the barometric pressure by 0.5 inch (+0.2 inch additional per Rank) and/or cause 12 inches of precipitation to fall (+6 inches per Rank) within a radius of 5 miles (+1 additional mile per Rank) by spending 1 hour to perform this ritual. The Adept cannot move or engage in any other activity during that time. He can maintain these alterations in the weather as long as he maintains his concentration on them (maximum of 1 hour+1 additional hour per Rank). The Base Chance of effectively employing this ritual is 9%; 5 is added to this number for each Rank the Adept has achieved with the ritual, The Experience Multiple for this ritual is 450, and if a backfire occurs, the weather affects the Adept.
entries.nome: Rituale di Controllo del tempo atmosferico
entries.testo_it: Con un'ora di rituale l'Adept raduna nubi temporalesche, alza o abbassa la temperatura di 5 gradi (+1 per Rank), la pressione di 0,5 pollici (+0,2 per Rank) e/o fa cadere 12 pollici di precipitazioni (+6 per Rank) entro 5 miglia (+1 miglio per Rank). Durante il rituale non può muoversi né fare altro. Mantiene i cambiamenti finché resta concentrato (massimo 1 ora +1 ora per Rank). La Base Chance è 9% +5 per Rank; il Moltiplicatore XP è 450; in caso di contraccolpo il tempo colpisce l'Adept.

entries.name: Ritual of Summoning and Controlling Air Elemental
entries.text: The Adept can summon an Air Elemental and temporarily bind him to service in exactly the same manner (and with the same type of results) as described for the summoning of Fire Elementals in 42.7, with the exception that the summoning of an Air Elemental requires an open or semi-enclosed area.
