entries.effects: The Adept casts a bolt of starfire at any one target within range. The first entity or object the bolt hits along its flight path suffers [D-4] (+1 per Rank) damage unless he/it resists.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept scaglia un dardo di fuoco stellare contro un bersaglio entro la portata. La prima entità o oggetto colpito lungo la traiettoria subisce D10-4 (+1 per Rank) danni, se non resiste.

entries.name: Meteor Spell
entries.effects: The Adept calls down from the heavens a meteor with a 25 foot diameter that crashes into an area within range, doing [D4] (+1 per Rank) damage to all entities within the impact area who fail to resist. The meteor must be targeted to hit a specific hex and takes 2 minutes to arrive (-10 seconds per Rank). Only Dark Mages and Star Mages can use this spell.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept fa precipitare dal cielo una meteora di 25 piedi di diametro su un'area entro la portata: tutte le entità nella zona d'impatto che non resistono subiscono D10+4 (+1 per Rank) danni. La meteora va diretta su un esagono preciso e arriva in 2 minuti (-10 secondi per Rank). Solo Maghi oscuri e Maghi delle stelle possono usarlo.

entries.name: Shadow Wings Spell
entries.effects: The caster creates great batwings of darkness on himself or any single character within range. These wings will bear the target through the sky wherever he desires at a rate of 30 miles per hour (+1 mile an hour per Rank). This spell can only be cast by Shadow Weavers and Dark Mages.
entries.testo_it: L'incantatore fa spuntare grandi ali di pipistrello fatte d'ombra su se stesso o su un personaggio entro la portata. Le ali portano il bersaglio in volo dove desidera a 30 miglia orarie (+1 miglio orario per Rank). Possono lanciarlo solo Tessitori d'ombra e Maghi oscuri.

entries.name: Web of Starlight Spell
entries.resist_text: Can only be passively resisted (then suffers half damage).
entries.effects: This spell operates in the same manner as the Web of Fire (S-4, p.50) of the College of Fire Magics except that it affects only creatures of night and shadow who must, if damaged, roll on the Fright Table. It can only be cast by Star Mages. Entities that are not creatures of night and shadow can ignore the web entirely. See 42.6 for details.
entries.nome: Incantesimo della Rete di luce stellare
entries.testo_it: Funziona come la Rete di fuoco (S-4) del Collegio delle Magie del Fuoco, ma colpisce solo le creature della notte e dell'ombra, che se subiscono danni devono tirare sulla Tabella della paura. Possono lanciarlo solo i Maghi delle stelle. Le entità che non sono creature della notte e dell'ombra possono ignorare del tutto la rete. Vedi 42.6 per i dettagli.
entries.resistenza_it: Solo resistenza passiva (chi resiste subisce metà danno)

entries.name: Web of Blackness Spell
entries.resist_text: Can only be passively resisted (then suffers half damage).
entries.effects: This spell is identical in all ways to 5-6 above except that it affects only creatures of light and can only be cast by a Dark Mage ora Shadow Weaver.
entries.note: Come S-6 ma colpisce solo creature della luce; solo Dark Mage o Shadow Weaver.
entries.testo_it: Identico in tutto a S-6, ma colpisce solo le creature della luce e possono lanciarlo solo Maghi oscuri o Tessitori d'ombra.
entries.resistenza_it: Solo resistenza passiva (chi resiste subisce metà danno)

entries.name: Meteor Swarm Spell
entries.effects: This spell has the same effect as 5-4 (Meteor Spell) except that 3 meteors are summoned. At least one cubic foot of each meteor must overlap with one cubic foot of another meteor.-The-meteors..will_arrive.in.5. minutes (-20 seconds per Rank). Only Star Mages can cast this spell.
entries.testo_it: Come la Meteora (S-4), ma le meteore evocate sono 3, e ognuna deve sovrapporsi a un'altra per almeno un piede cubo. Arrivano in 5 minuti (-20 secondi per Rank). Possono lanciarlo solo i Maghi delle stelle.

entries.name: Dwarf Star Spell
entries.effects: The spell causes one target of the Adept's choice that is within range to suffer the effects of an increase in the force of gravity of 1 gravity (+1 additional gravity per Rank) unless the target resists.
entries.testo_it: Un bersaglio a scelta entro la portata subisce un aumento della forza di gravità di 1 g (+1 g per Rank), se non resiste.

entries.name: Black Fire Spell
entries.effects: The Adept throws from his fingertips a column of black flames 30 feet long and 5 feet wide. He can increase the length or width by 1 foot per Rank. All targets occupying hexes through which the fire passes must resist or suffer [D -4] (+1 per Rank) damage and must roll on the Fright Table. The Base Chance of infection is increased by 20 if a character suffers damage from this spell (see 24).
entries.testo_it: Dalle dita dell'Adept parte una colonna di fiamme nere lunga 30 piedi e larga 5; può aumentare lunghezza o larghezza di 1 piede per Rank. Tutti i bersagli negli esagoni attraversati devono resistere o subire D10-4 (+1 per Rank) danni e tirare sulla Tabella della paura. Chi subisce danni ha +20 alla probabilità di infezione (vedi 24).

entries.name: Spell of Shadow Walking
entries.range: Can only be cast over self
entries.effects: The Adept can cause himself to be instantly transported from one spot that is in shadow to another spot that is within shadow. The destination must be in sight or must have been carefully observed beforehand. The destination can also be up to 5 miles (+1 additional mile per Rank) from the spot the Adept currently occupies. Only Shadow Weavers can use this spell.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept si trasporta all'istante da un punto in ombra a un altro punto in ombra. La destinazione deve essere in vista o osservata con attenzione in precedenza, e può distare fino a 5 miglia (+1 miglio per Rank). Possono usarlo solo i Tessitori d'ombra.

entries.name: Spell of Whitefire
entries.effects: This spell is cast at a single target of the Adept's choice that is within range. The target must resist or it will be flash fried. The target's Willpower must be less than the modified chance of casting the spell or it will have no effect upon him, though it can backfire.
entries.testo_it: Si lancia su un bersaglio entro la portata, che deve resistere o viene incenerito all'istante. Non ha effetto se la Volontà del bersaglio supera la probabilità di lancio modificata (ma l'incantesimo può comunque avere un contraccolpo).

entries.name: Spell of Fear
entries.effects: One target of the Adept’s choice that is within range is seized by almost uncontrollable fear. The target's player must, if the target fails to resist, roll on the Fright Table to determine the result of the spell (see 44.8, p.57).
entries.testo_it: Un bersaglio entro la portata è preso da una paura quasi incontrollabile. Se non resiste, il suo giocatore tira sulla Tabella della paura per stabilire l'effetto (vedi 44.8).

entries.name: Ritual of Conjuring and Controlling Dark Sphere
entries.text: The Adept can summon and control an inky black sphere from another dimension. The Adept must spend one hour performing the ritual and cannot move or perform any other activity during that time. At the end of the ritual, the Adept's player performs a Cast Check. The Base Chance for this ritual being successful is 1% +3 per Rank. If the ritual is successful the sphere will appear within 15 feet of the Adept and will continue to be directed by the Adept (moving ata TMR of 9) so long as he concentrates on it (maximum of 5 minutes +5 minutes per Rank). Once he stops concentrating, the sphere will immediately return to its own dimension. If the Adept fails to conjure the sphere, nothing at all happens. If a backfire results, the sphere appears, comes into contact with the caster, and then moves randomly about. Anything that comes in contact with the Dark Sphere and fails to resist is immediately disintegrated. Anything that resists simply suffers D10 damage for each contact and is thrown to the ground by the shock of contact. The Experience Multiple for this ritual is 450.
entries.nome: Rituale di Evocazione e controllo della Sfera oscura
entries.testo_it: L'Adept evoca e controlla una sfera nera come l'inchiostro proveniente da un'altra dimensione. Il rituale dura un'ora, durante la quale non può muoversi né fare altro; alla fine si fa il tiro di lancio. La Base Chance è 1% +3 per Rank. Se riesce, la sfera compare entro 15 piedi e l'Adept la dirige (si muove con TMR 9) finché resta concentrato su di essa (massimo 5 minuti +5 minuti per Rank); quando smette, la sfera torna subito nella sua dimensione. Se fallisce non succede nulla. Con un contraccolpo la sfera compare, tocca l'incantatore e poi si muove a caso. Ciò che tocca la Sfera oscura e non resiste viene disintegrato all'istante; chi resiste subisce D10 danni per ogni contatto e viene gettato a terra dall'urto. Il Moltiplicatore XP è 450.

colleges.name: Necromantic Conjurations
colleges.requirements: Adepts of the College of Necromantic Conjurations can practice their arts without restriction.
colleges.modifiers: The Base Chance of performing any talent, spell, or ritual of the College of Necromantic Conjurations is modified by the addition of the following numbers: It is a High Holiday of the “Powers of Light’* -10 It is a High Holiday of the College of Necromantic Conjurationst 20 It is the stroke of midnight on the night of one of the High Holidays of the College of Necromantic Con- jurationstt 50 *This modifier can include any holidays of the GM's invention that are dedicated to the “Powers of Light.” However, all such holidays are presumed to be known to all characters and must, therefore, be announced by the GM well in advance of the application of this modifier. }The College of Necromantic Conjura- tions recognizes one principle High Holiday: Walpurgisnacht. The GM can create other High Holidays as he sees fit (see note above). tiThis modifier is applied to any spell loosed at the stroke of midnight or to any ritual that is completed on the stroke of midnight. This modifier is applied instead of (nat in addition to) the +20 modifier for working the magic of this College on a High Holiday of the College. Other- wise, all modifiers are cumulative.

entries.name: Spell of Conjuring Darkness
entries.effects: The Adept creates a volume of darkness of variable intensity of 500 cubic feet ( +500 additional cubic feet per Rank). At Ranks 1-5, the darkness is equal to that found on cloudy night; at Ranks 6-10, to that found on an overcast moonless night; at Ranks 11 and above, to that of a sealed room with no light source.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept crea un volume di oscurità di intensità variabile di 500 piedi cubi (+500 piedi cubi per Rank). Ai Rank 1-5 l'oscurità è quella di una notte nuvolosa; ai Rank 6-10 quella di una notte coperta e senza luna; dal Rank 11 quella di una stanza sigillata senza alcuna fonte di luce.

entries.name: Spell of Putrescence
entries.effects: The Adept can, by casting this spell, spoil enough food to generously feed 1 person (+1 additional person per Rank). The food will thereafter be inedible,
entries.testo_it: L'Adept guasta abbastanza cibo da sfamare abbondantemente 1 persona (+1 persona per Rank). Da quel momento il cibo è immangiabile.

entries.name: Spell of Obscurement
entries.effects: The Adept creates a 5-foot cube of oily black smoke (+1 foot to each dimension per Rank). The vision of all entities except the Adept is reduced to 5 feet. The Adept's sight is unaffected, and any character who successfully resists is unaffected.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept crea un cubo di 5 piedi di fumo nero e oleoso (+1 piede per lato per Rank). La vista di tutte le entità tranne l'Adept si riduce a 5 piedi. La vista dell'Adept non è toccata, e chi resiste non subisce effetti.

entries.name: Fire and Brimstone Spell
entries.effects: The Adept can cast a bolt of sulphurous flame at a single target. If the target fails to resist, it takes [D-4] (+1 per Rank) damage. The Base Chance of infection is increased by 20 as a result of damage inflicted by this spell,
entries.testo_it: L'Adept scaglia un dardo di fiamma sulfurea contro un solo bersaglio. Se non resiste subisce D10-4 (+1 per Rank) danni. I danni di questo incantesimo aumentano di 20 la probabilità di infezione.

entries.name: Spell of Heating Metal
entries.effects: The Adept can cause up to 1 cubic foot of metal (+1 additional cubic foot per Rank) to become hot, increasing its temperature by 5°F+5° per Rank. Target is wary and suffers a subtraction of 5 from all Strike Chances for remainTarget flies into a berserk rage and immediately attempts to attack (within the limits of movement) the object of his rage (the Adept or manifestation that brought about the fear). He will Charge if possible and attempt to Grapple. All Strike Checks against him are increased by 10 and all Strike Checks that he Target flees as rapidly as possible away from the source of his terror. Character is immobilized as if stunned and adds 5 to all subsequent rolls on the Target becomes hysterical and will continue to stand in place and scream until snapped out of it (GM determines how this occurs). Add 15 to subsequent rolls Target becomes totally catatonic (as if stunned). Add 15 to subsequent rolls on the Fright Table this day. Target has a 5% chance his hair turns permanently Target faints dead away (collapsing to the ground). He remains unconscious for [D +6] minutes. Add 10 to all subsequent rolls on the Fright Table this day. Target suffers a heart attack, The result is the same as for 101-106 except that the target cannot move about under his own power for the remainder of the day and suffers a decrease of 2 in all characteristics until he has spent one month resting in [44.8] FRIGHT TABLE Dice --- Result 01-20 der of Pulse. 21-25 makes are also increased by 10. 26-76 77-90 Fright Table this day. 91-95 on the Fright Table this day. 96-100 white. : 101-106 107-110 bed. i+ Target suffers a heart attack and must have medical attention (cardiovascular resuscitation) within one minute (12 Pulses of combat) or die. If he does survive, all subsequent rolls on the Fright Table are increased by 20 this day.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept fa scaldare fino a 1 piede cubo di metallo (+1 piede cubo per Rank), alzandone la temperatura di 5 gradi Fahrenheit +5 gradi per Rank.

entries.name: Spell of Harming Entity
entries.effects: The Adept can cast this spell at any one target within range. If the target fails to resist, he will be in intense agony for the duration of the spell and must check to see if his concentration is broken. His Strike Chance is reduced by 10 for the duration of the spell. He suffers no damage as a result of the spell.
entries.testo_it: Si lancia su un bersaglio entro la portata. Se non resiste, prova un dolore lancinante per tutta la durata e deve verificare se perde la concentrazione. La sua Strike Chance si riduce di 10 per la durata. Non subisce danni.

entries.name: Spell of Noxious Vapors
entries.effects: The Adept creates a cloud of foul yellow vapor that will affect all characters (including the Adept) who are caught within it. The cloud covers the entire area within range of the Adept. At Ranks 0-5, it reduces each character's range of vision by 10 feet. At Ranks 6-10, it causes a light sleep lasting until the spell ends or the sleeper is awakened. At Ranks 11who fails to resist will contract consumption (a wasting disease that can be cured by a Healer).
entries.testo_it: L'Adept crea una nube di vapore giallo e fetido che colpisce tutti i personaggi al suo interno, Adept compreso. La nube copre tutta l'area entro la portata. Ai Rank 0-5 riduce la vista di ogni personaggio di 10 piedi. Ai Rank 6-10 provoca un sonno leggero che dura finché l'incantesimo non termina o il dormiente non viene svegliato. Dal Rank 11 chi non resiste contrae la consunzione (una malattia debilitante che un Guaritore può curare).
entries.durata_it: 10 secondi x (D10-5) x Rank (x1 senza Rank)

entries.name: Spell of Warping Wood
entries.effects: The Adept can twist a 2” X2" x1! area of a piece of wood into any shape of his choosing. He can add 2 inches to any single dimension per Rank.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept può deformare a piacere un pezzo di legno di 2 x 2 x 1 pollici. Può aggiungere 2 pollici a una dimensione per Rank.

entries.name: Ram of Force Spell
entries.effects: Creates a 3' diameter, 15' long invisible “column of force” that will follow the Adept's command to move (with a TMR of 7), exert pressure, and then dissipate. This column will exert enough pressure across its narrowest face (only) todo {D +1] (+2 per Rank) points of damage per Pulse against an unyielding surface. This damage will eventually break through any substance, given enough time. The GM _ must adjudicate how many points of damage a particular substance has, Yielding substances will be pushed at arate of 21 feet per Pulse (about 3 miles an hour). The column itself can be attacked with magic or magical weapons and dissipates when it has taken 15 {+3 per Rank) points of damage. The column can be seen with Witchsight.
entries.testo_it: Crea una colonna di forza invisibile di 3 piedi di diametro e 15 di lunghezza che, al comando dell'Adept, si muove (con TMR 7), spinge e poi si dissolve. Premendo con la sola faccia più stretta infligge D10+1 (+2 per Rank) danni per Pulse contro una superficie rigida, e col tempo sfonda qualunque materiale (il GM stabilisce quanti danni regge ogni sostanza). I materiali cedevoli vengono spinti di 21 piedi per Pulse (circa 3 miglia orarie). La colonna si può attaccare con la magia o con armi magiche e si dissolve dopo aver subito 15 (+3 per Rank) danni. Si può vedere con la Vista stregata.

entries.name: Spell of Vapor Breathing
entries.range: Can only be cast over self
entries.effects: The spell permits the Adept to breathe any atmosphere that contains sufficient oxygen to keep him alive, filtering out other substances. This spell does not permit the Adept to breathe underwater.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept può respirare qualunque atmosfera contenga abbastanza ossigeno da tenerlo in vita, filtrando le altre sostanze. Non permette di respirare sott'acqua.

entries.name: Ritual of Summoning and Binding Lesser Undead
entries.text: The Adept can use this ritual to summon and bind the Lesser Undead if he remains stationary within a protective circle drawn in or near an area where Lesser Undead can habitually be found (near tombs, graveyards, barrows, etc.). ‘The Adept and his companions must remain within the circle of protection during the entire course of the ritual. They can take no other action while the ritual is taking place. The ritual lasts 10 hours {- i hour per every 2 ranks), witha minimum of one hour. At the end of that time, the Adept's player rolls D100. If the resulting number is equal to or less than the Adept’s Magical Aptitude, the ritual succeeds. In addition, 3 per Rank is added to the Adept's Magical Aptitude. If the Adept's player rolls number 40 or more greater than the Modified Chance for this ritual to be effective, the ritual backfires and the appropriate number of undead appear unbound within the circle and can attack the Adept and his companions. The ritual summons 1 (+1 per Rank) Lesser Undead and (unless it backfires) subjects them to the will of the summoner for as long as his concentration lasts (one week maximum). Once the Adept’s concentration is broken or he releases the undead, they are free to attack him and his companions, If the ritual backfires or concentration is broken, the Lesser Undead will attempt to attack the summoner if possible, The Experience Multiple for this ritual is 250. Undead summoned successfully (i.e., not as a result of a backfire) will appear within 20 feet of the summoner's protective circle.
entries.nome: Rituale di Evocazione e vincolo dei non-morti minori
entries.testo_it: L'Adept evoca e vincola Non-morti minori restando fermo in un cerchio di protezione tracciato in un luogo dove se ne trovano abitualmente, o vicino (tombe, cimiteri, tumuli, ecc.). L'Adept e i compagni devono restare nel cerchio per tutto il rituale senza fare altro. Il rituale dura 10 ore (-1 ora ogni 2 Rank), minimo un'ora. Alla fine il giocatore tira D100: con un risultato pari o inferiore all'Attitudine magica (+3 per Rank) il rituale riesce. Con 40 o più sopra la probabilità modificata ha un contraccolpo: i non-morti compaiono liberi dentro il cerchio e possono attaccare l'Adept e i compagni. Il rituale evoca 1 (+1 per Rank) Non-morto minore che compare entro 20 piedi dal cerchio e, salvo contraccolpo, obbedisce all'evocatore finché dura la sua concentrazione (massimo una settimana). Quando la concentrazione si spezza o l'Adept li libera, sono liberi di attaccarlo insieme ai compagni, e con un contraccolpo o una concentrazione spezzata cercano di attaccare l'evocatore. Il Moltiplicatore XP è 250.

entries.name: Ritual of Converse with the Dead
entries.text: The Adept can converse with a dead entity if he occupies the place the entity died or was buried and calls forth the dead spirit using this “ritual; ‘The ritual takes‘an hour -to-perform-and must be cast in a protective circle. The Adept must have known of the death (by witness, hearsay, or reading) in order to summon the dead spirit. He need not have known or encountered the entity before. He must understand a language spoken by the entity. The Adept's player rolls D100 at the end of the ritual and if the result is equal to the Base Chance of performing the ritual, the spirit of the deceased appears and will answer three questions. Each question will be answered with a riddle or puzzle. The Base Chance of this ritual being effective is equal to the Adept's Magical Aptitude (+4 per Rank). The dead disappear whenever any character who is not within the protective circle occupies the same general area. The Experience Multiple for this ritual is 400. The GM creates all riddles and puzzles in answer to the Adept's questions. Undead can not be summoned or conversed with using this ritual.
entries.nome: Rituale di Dialogo con i morti
entries.testo_it: L'Adept può parlare con un morto se si trova nel luogo dove l'entità è morta o è sepolta e ne richiama lo spirito con questo rituale, che dura un'ora e va eseguito in un cerchio di protezione. L'Adept deve essere a conoscenza della morte (per averla vista, sentita raccontare o letta), anche senza aver mai conosciuto l'entità, e deve capire una lingua che questa parlava. Alla fine il giocatore tira D100: con un risultato pari o inferiore alla Base Chance (Attitudine magica +4 per Rank) lo spirito compare e risponde a tre domande, ciascuna con un indovinello o un enigma, che il GM inventa. Lo spirito svanisce appena un personaggio fuori dal cerchio si trova nella stessa zona. I non-morti non si possono evocare né interrogare con questo rituale. Il Moltiplicatore XP è 400.

entries.name: Spell of Causing Wounds
entries.effects: The Adept can cause [D -4] (+1 per Rank) damage as a result of wounds to one target within range unless that target successfully resists. If the target suffers any effective damage he suffers an increase of 10 to the chance of infection as a result of his injuries.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept infligge D10-4 (+1 per Rank) danni da ferita a un bersaglio entro la portata, se non resiste. Se il bersaglio subisce danni effettivi, la sua probabilità di infezione aumenta di 10.

entries.name: Wall of Force Spell
entries.effects: The Adept creates a1" thick wall of force that is 10 feet high and 20 feet long or a1” thick, 10 foot high ring with a radius of 5 feet. The Adept can increase the height or length by 1 foot (or radius by 3 inches) per Rank. Any entity coming in contact with the Wall of Force will either successfully resist or be thrown back (falling Prone) and suffer [D -5] (+1 per Rank) damage.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept crea un muro di forza spesso 1 pollice, alto 10 piedi e lungo 20, oppure un anello spesso 1 pollice e alto 10 piedi con raggio di 5. Può aumentare altezza o lunghezza di 1 piede (o il raggio di 3 pollici) per Rank. Chi tocca il muro deve resistere o viene respinto (cade a terra) e subisce D10-5 (+1 per Rank) danni.

entries.name: Wall of Bones Spell
entries.effects: The Adept conjures a wall of interlaced bones 1 foot thick, 10 feet high, and 20 feet long or a circle of bones 1 foot thick, 10 feet high and with a 5 foot radius. The Adept can increase the height and thickness by 1 foot and the radius by 3 inches per Rank. An entity coming in sight of the wall must either successfully resist or roll on the Fright Table (see 44.8). The wall can suffer 100 points of damage and then turns to dust. Bright sunlight inflicts 20 points per Pulse on the wall.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept evoca un muro di ossa intrecciate spesso 1 piede, alto 10 e lungo 20, oppure un cerchio di ossa spesso 1 piede e alto 10 con raggio di 5. Può aumentare altezza e spessore di 1 piede e il raggio di 3 pollici per Rank. Chi vede il muro deve resistere o tirare sulla Tabella della paura (vedi 44.8). Il muro regge 100 danni e poi si riduce in polvere; la luce del sole piena gli infligge 20 danni per Pulse.

entries.name: Spell of Fear
entries.effects: The spell has the same effect as the spell of the same name (5-13, p.56) of the College of Celestial Magics.
entries.testo_it: Ha lo stesso effetto dell'incantesimo omonimo (S-13) del Collegio delle Magie celesti.

entries.name: Mass Fear Spell
entries.effects: The spell has the same effects as the Spell of Fear (S-13, p.56) of the College of Celestial Magics except that all characters within range except the Adept must resist or roll on the Fright Table.
entries.testo_it: Ha gli stessi effetti della Paura (S-13) del Collegio delle Magie celesti, ma tutti i personaggi entro la portata, tranne l'Adept, devono resistere o tirare sulla Tabella della paura.

entries.name: Spell of Scarring Terrain
entries.effects: The Adept causes terrible ruin by burning out an area of ground equal to 25 square feet (+25 additional square feet per Rank). The ground will be so damaged that it will be unable to support any flora for the duration of the spell. Though the spell will immediately wither any flora in the area it affects, fauna will be unaffected.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept devasta un'area di terreno di 25 piedi quadrati (+25 piedi quadrati per Rank), bruciandola. Il terreno è così danneggiato che non può ospitare vegetazione per tutta la durata. Le piante nell'area appassiscono subito, ma gli animali non subiscono effetti.

entries.name: Spell of Animation of the Dead
entries.effects: The Adept animates 3 (+1 per Rank) human-sized corpses within range. They will serve the Adept in all ways. If the corpses are recently dead, they will be zombies. If they have been dead for more than a month, they will be partially devoid of skin and will be treated as skeletons for purposes of this spell. Corpses of other than human size are adjudicated by the GM.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept anima 3 (+1 per Rank) cadaveri di taglia umana entro la portata, che lo servono in tutto. Se sono morti da poco diventano zombi; se sono morti da più di un mese sono in parte privi di pelle e contano come scheletri. Il GM decide per i cadaveri di taglia diversa da quella umana.

entries.name: Wraithcloak Spell
entries.effects: The Adept causes the target to appear less corporeal and to be harder to hit. The chance of successfully Striking the target of the spell is reduced by 1 (+2 per Rank) for the duration of the spell. In addition, the target's stealth is increased by 10.
entries.testo_it: Il bersaglio appare meno corporeo ed è più difficile da colpire: la probabilità di colpirlo si riduce di 1 (+2 per Rank) per la durata. Inoltre la sua furtività aumenta di 10.

entries.name: Shadowed Weapon Spell
entries.effects: The Adept can increase the usefulness of any weapon within range. The affected weapon has its Base Chance increased by 1 (+2 per Rank) and its damage increased by 1 for every 3 Ranks (or fraction of 3 Ranks), At Rank 6 or above, the Adept can create a sword entirely of darkness that will operate in the same manner as a normal sword of its type (broadsword, tulwar, etc.) that has had a Shadowed Weapon Spell of the appropriate Rank cast over it.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept potenzia un'arma entro la portata: la sua Base Chance aumenta di 1 (+2 per Rank) e il danno di 1 ogni 3 Rank (o frazione). Dal Rank 6 l'Adept può creare una spada fatta interamente di tenebra, che funziona come una normale spada del suo tipo (spada larga, tulwar, ecc.) con su un'Arma d'ombra del Rank corrispondente.
entries.durata_it: 20 secondi x (D10-5) x Rank (x1 senza Rank)

entries.name: Hand of Death Spell
entries.effects: The Adept causes any single target to sense the Adept's hand squeezing his heart or similar organ to a pulp. Even if the character resists, the sensation will remain and will break the character's concentration and subtract 10 from the character's Base Chance of hitting another character or successfully performing magic. If the character fails to resist, he suffers [D +1] damage that Pulse and each succeeding Pulse that the spell remains in effect and he fails to resist. The spell remains in effect so long as the Adept expends 2 Fatigue and implements a Pass Action each Pulse. During this time, the Adept must make visible squeezing motions with his hand to simulate the squeezing of the victim's organs. The Adept need not recast the spell once he successfully looses it at his victim. Even if the victim resists, the spell will continue to operate so long as the Adept continues to make squeezing motions.
entries.testo_it: Il bersaglio sente la mano dell'Adept che gli stritola il cuore o un altro organo. Anche se resiste la sensazione rimane: perde la concentrazione e ha -10 alla Base Chance di colpire e di lanciare magie. Se non resiste subisce D10+1 danni in quel Pulse e in ogni Pulse successivo in cui l'incantesimo resta attivo e lui non resiste. L'incantesimo resta attivo finché l'Adept spende 2 Fatica e compie un'azione Passa ogni Pulse, mimando con la mano il gesto di stritolare gli organi della vittima. Non serve rilanciarlo una volta scagliato con successo: anche se la vittima resiste, continua finché l'Adept continua a stringere.

entries.name: Spell of Invisible Fire
entries.resist_text: Can only be passively resisted (then suffers half damage).
entries.effects: This spell operates in the same manner as the Spell of Invisible Fire (S-9, p.51) of the College of Fire,
entries.testo_it: Funziona come il Fuoco invisibile (S-9) del Collegio delle Magie del Fuoco.
entries.resistenza_it: Solo resistenza passiva (chi resiste subisce metà danno)

entries.name: Spell of Life Draining
entries.effects: The Adept drains 1 (+1 per Rank) Fatigue from the target if the target fails to resist, The Fatigue can be used to repair the Adept's own Fatigue or Endurance or to increase his Physical Strength for “[D+1 per Rank] Pulses on a one for one basis. If the target has no Fatigue remaining, the Adept can drain from Endurance instead. He cannot drain from both Fatigue and Endurance in the same Pulse.
entries.testo_it: Se il bersaglio non resiste, l'Adept gli sottrae 1 (+1 per Rank) Fatica. Può usarla per recuperare la propria Fatica o Resistenza, oppure per aumentare la propria Forza fisica (uno a uno) per D10 +1 per Rank Pulse. Se il bersaglio non ha più Fatica, l'Adept può sottrargli Resistenza, ma non entrambe nello stesso Pulse.

entries.name: Spell of Agony
entries.effects: The spell causes all entities in the affected area except the Adept to suffer extreme agony. No character who does not resist can take any action except to Pass. Characters who successfully resist reduce all Strike Chances by 30 and take twice as long to perform any action.
entries.testo_it: Tutte le entità nell'area colpita, tranne l'Adept, provano un dolore atroce. Chi non resiste non può fare altro che Passare. Chi resiste ha -30 a tutte le Strike Chance e impiega il doppio del tempo per qualunque azione.

entries.name: Phantasm Spell
entries.effects: This spell is the same as the spell of the same name (S-3) of the College of Sorceries of the Mind.
entries.testo_it: Uguale all'incantesimo omonimo (S-3) del Collegio delle Stregonerie della mente.

entries.name: Ritual of Summoning and Binding Greater Undead
entries.text: This ritual works in the same manner and under the same conditions as the Ritual of Summoning and Binding Lesser Undead (Q-1) except that the Base Chance is always half {round down) the Adept’s Magical Aptitude and the Experience Multiple is 350. The ritual summons Greater Undead and must be cast in or near an area frequented by them (barrows, churchyards, or abandoned dwellings).
entries.nome: Rituale di Evocazione e vincolo dei non-morti maggiori
entries.testo_it: Funziona come il rituale di Evocare e vincolare non-morti minori (Q-1), alle stesse condizioni, ma la Base Chance è sempre metà (per difetto) dell'Attitudine magica dell'Adept e il Moltiplicatore XP è 350. Evoca Non-morti maggiori e va eseguito in luoghi da loro frequentati o vicino (tumuli, cimiteri di chiesa, abitazioni abbandonate).

entries.name: Ritual of Life Prolonging
entries.text: The Adept can prolong his life, remaining unchanged and unaged for the duration of the effects of this ritual. Once the effects of the ritual wear off, the Adept will begin to age at the rate of 1 year per minute until he reaches the proper biological age to match his chronological age. The Adept must remain stationary and can take no other action while performing the ritual. At the end of the ritual, the Adept's player rolls D100. If the result is less than or equal to the Base Chance (5% +5 per Rank), the ritual is effective. If the ritual backfires, the Adept will increase his age instead of decreasing it or keeping it unchanged. Normally, the ritual's effects last for 2 years (+2 additional years per Rank), but at Rank 10 and above, the Adept can immediately upon the ritual being completed reduce his biological age by up to 2 years (+2 years per Rank) instead of (not in addition to) halting aging. Any backfire reverses the anticipated effect (accelerating aging). The Experience Multiple for this ritual is 350. The ritual takes 8 hours.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept prolunga la propria vita, restando immutato e senza invecchiare per la durata degli effetti. Quando gli effetti cessano invecchia di 1 anno al minuto fino a raggiungere l'età biologica corrispondente a quella anagrafica. Il rituale dura 8 ore, durante le quali l'Adept resta fermo senza fare altro. Alla fine il giocatore tira D100: con un risultato pari o inferiore alla Base Chance (5% +5 per Rank) il rituale riesce. Di norma gli effetti durano 2 anni (+2 anni per Rank); dal Rank 10 l'Adept può invece (non in aggiunta) ridurre subito la propria età biologica fino a 2 anni (+2 anni per Rank). Un contraccolpo inverte l'effetto atteso e accelera l'invecchiamento. Il Moltiplicatore XP è 350.

entries.name: Ritual of Becoming Undead
entries.text: The Adept can become an undead by employing this ritual. Once he joins the ranks of the undead, he cannot reverse the effect. The Adept must draw two cocentric protective circles and remain within the outer one throughout the ritual. The ritual takes 2 hours to perform. During the course of the ritual, a Wight appears in the inner circle at Rank 0-10, or a Wraith at Rank 11-20. This undead is bound to the place until freed by someone other than the Adept entering or leaving the circles, If released before the ritual is successfully completed, the undead will hunt the Adept and attempt to terminate his existence in revenge. Once the ritual is performed, the GM checks to determine if it was a success. The Base Chance that it will be a success is 10% (+3 per Rank). If it is a success, the Adept joins the ranks of the undead as the Greater Undead type of his choice and the Undead creature is dismissed. If the result is not a success and the Adept fails to become undead, the undead imprisoned therein will be released if the Adept attempts to leave the outer circle. If the ritual backfires, the undead will immediately be released and will attack the Adept inside the protective circles (which will be broken and will not keep the undead imprisoned). The Experience Multiple of this ritual is 550.
entries.testo_it: L'Adept diventa un non-morto; una volta entrato fra i non-morti non può tornare indietro. Deve tracciare due cerchi di protezione concentrici e restare in quello esterno per tutto il rituale, che dura 2 ore. Durante il rituale nel cerchio interno compare uno Spettro dei tumuli (Rank 0-10) o un Wraith (Rank 11-20), vincolato al luogo finché qualcuno che non sia l'Adept non entra o esce dai cerchi. Se viene liberato prima che il rituale riesca, darà la caccia all'Adept per vendetta. Alla fine il GM verifica l'esito: la Base Chance è 10% (+3 per Rank). Se riesce, l'Adept diventa un Non-morto maggiore del tipo che preferisce e la creatura viene congedata. Se fallisce, la creatura imprigionata viene liberata se l'Adept tenta di uscire dal cerchio esterno. Con un contraccolpo la creatura viene subito liberata e attacca l'Adept dentro i cerchi (che si spezzano e non la trattengono più). Il Moltiplicatore XP è 550.

colleges.name: Summoning
colleges.requirements: Adepts of the College of Summoning are restricted in several ways. An entity cannot be summoned or bound by an Adept if it is already bound by another Adept. In addition, an entity cannot be summoned to leave its natural habitat and enter some other habitat that it does not nor- mally frequent. Sufficient space must be available in which an entity could materialize before that entity can be conjured. An entity can be con- jured into an environment in which it could not survive, but arrives in that environment dead or dying. A fish conjured from the ocean onto dry land, for instance, would arrive near death. The time required for a summoned or conjured creature to arrive is never 0. How- ever if the spell parameters would seem to allow this, the summoned entity arrives in the next lowest time (i.e. creatures summoned by 5-1 can arrive in a minimum of 30 seconds). Note that summoning times are generic aver- ages and can be altered by the GM to fit spe- cific circumstances. An Adept can successfully communicate commands to a bound entity only if the Adept has also cast a spell of communication over the entity, or the entity is affected by the opera- tions of T1 of this College. When an Adept attempts a summoning spell, there is a chance (determined by the enti- ty‘s class) that the summoned entity will attack someone, something, and/or the Adept and his party. This reaction chance can be modified if the GM feels the characters have taken actions that would either antagonize or appease the entity.

entries.name: Spell of Binding Lesser Beasts
entries.effects: The Adept can bind to his will any one (+1/Rank) monster that is within range and is a member of one of the following groups: Apes and Prehumans, Felines, Small Land Mammals, Common Avians, Fish, Other Aquatics, Lizards and Kindred, Snakes, Insects and Spiders, Lesser Undead, and Riding Animals. Upon casting this spell, the Adept must announce what type of monster he wishes to affect with this spell. Only one type of monster from among all of these classes will be affected by each cast, though any number of binding spells can be in effect at the same time. A monster bound by this spell immediately ceases all action at the moment the spell takes effect. It becomes stationary and remains so until given orders by the Adept who is exercising the binding. If the Adept cannot communicate with a bound monster, the monster remains stationary until the binding is broken. Once communication is established (via T-1 or G-10), the Adept can order the monster to do his bidding, and it will obey his orders without hesitation. However, a bound monster will obey orders literally. If told to attack another monster, for instance, it will attack immediately and continuously until told to stop. If the object of the attack is killed, the bound monster will continue to attack the corpse. Similarly, if told to march west, the monster will march in the direction ordered, even over a precipice, without complaint, unless told to stop upon reaching such a precipice. Bound entities need not remain within range of the Adept for the binding to remain in effect. Note: This spell requires a good deal of interaction between the GM and the Adept’s player. It is recommended that the GM require the Adept's player to state aloud the exact wording of any order, even if it is communicated telepathically. The GM then determines case by case what interpretation is to be placed upon the order by the bound subject. There is no rule that all bound subjects must react in the same manner to the same order, so much is left to the creativity of the GM. A binding of this type is broken whenever a General Knowledge Counterspell of this College is successfully cast over the bound subject or the space they occupy as part of a Ritual of Dissipation (Q-1 of the College of Naming Incantations) or whenever a counterspell is cast over the bound subject or the area they occupy by the Adept controlling it. This type of binding does not require that the Adept maintain concentration upon the subject to maintain the spell. Once bound, the subject cannot break the binding alone. Unless the (*1, if binding is dissipated as described herein, the subject will remain bound for the duration of the spell. An Adept can have bound at any one time a number of subjects equal to his Rank (+1) with this spell. He can have bound at the same time subjects of any number of classes, so long as he does not have bound more subjects than he is capable of controlling. Whenever an Adept attempts to bind one or more subjects that would cause him to exceed his Rank +1, the spell automatically fails (no backfire), and any previously bound subjects are released as though the Adept had performed a Counterspell over them. In all cases, every 10 pike or piranha,and every 30 killer bees or fire ants, count as one monster for purposes of this spell. Whenever a binding is broken, there is a 70% chance that the bound monsters will attack someone or something, usually the closest entity.
entries.nome: Incantesimo di Vincolo delle bestie minori
entries.testo_it: L'Adept vincola alla sua volontà un mostro (+1 per Rank) entro la portata dei gruppi Scimmie e preumani, Felini, Piccoli mammiferi terrestri, Uccelli comuni, Pesci, Altri acquatici, Lucertole e affini, Serpenti, Insetti e ragni, Non-morti minori e Animali da cavalcatura. Al lancio dichiara il tipo di mostro: ogni lancio ne colpisce un solo tipo, ma più vincoli possono essere attivi insieme. Il mostro vincolato si ferma all'istante e resta immobile finché l'Adept non gli dà ordini; se l'Adept non può comunicare con lui (con T-1 o G-10), resta fermo finché il vincolo non si spezza. Obbedisce senza esitare ma alla lettera: se gli si ordina di attaccare, attacca senza sosta finché non gli si dice di smettere, anche il cadavere; se gli si ordina di marciare verso ovest, lo fa anche oltre un precipizio. Il soggetto non deve restare entro la portata e l'Adept non deve concentrarsi. Si consiglia al GM di far dire ad alta voce le parole esatte di ogni ordine e di decidere caso per caso come lo interpreta il soggetto. Il vincolo si spezza con un controincantesimo di Conoscenza generale di questo Collegio lanciato sul soggetto o sul suo spazio nell'ambito di un Rituale di dissoluzione (Q-1 delle Invocazioni dei nomi), oppure con un controincantesimo dell'Adept stesso; il soggetto da solo non può liberarsi, e altrimenti resta vincolato per tutta la durata. L'Adept può tenere vincolati insieme al massimo Rank +1 soggetti, di qualunque classe: se tenta di superare il limite l'incantesimo fallisce (senza contraccolpo) e tutti i soggetti già vincolati vengono liberati. Ogni 10 lucci o piranha e ogni 30 api assassine o formiche di fuoco contano come un mostro. Quando un vincolo si spezza c'è il 70% di probabilità che i mostri attacchino qualcuno o qualcosa, di solito l'entità più vicina.

entries.name: Wall of Thorns Spell
entries.effects: The Adept can cause a wall of thorns to grow out of any soil (but not out of solid rock). The wall will be 1 foot thick, 10 feet high, and 20 feet long. The Adept can instead choose to have the wall take the form of a circle 1 foot thick, 10 feet high, and with a radius of 5 feet. The Adept can increase the height and thickness by 3 inches per Rank. An entity touching the wall will either successfully resist or suffer D--3 damage (not absorbed by armor) due to wounds inflicted by the enchanted thorns. The wall can be destroyed by chopping it down (or a hole can be cut through which the party can pass). However, only magical or silvered weapons will cut through the entangled branches and thorns. A full 100 points of damage are required to chop down the wall entirely; to successfully chop a hole through the wall requires 10 points (+1/ Rank of the creating Adept).
entries.testo_it: L'Adept fa crescere da qualunque terreno (ma non dalla roccia viva) un muro di spine spesso 1 piede, alto 10 e lungo 20, oppure un cerchio spesso 1 piede e alto 10 con raggio di 5. Può aumentare altezza e spessore di 3 pollici per Rank. Chi tocca il muro deve resistere o subire D10-3 danni (non assorbiti dall'armatura) dalle spine incantate. Il muro si può abbattere o aprirvi un varco, ma solo con armi magiche o argentate: per abbatterlo servono 100 danni, per aprire un varco 10 (+1 per Rank dell'Adept che l'ha creato).

entries.name: Spell of Summoning Fog

The fog will arrive in 10 minutes (30 seconds/ Rank) and will reduce visibility to 20 feet (-2/ Rank). It will last unti! burned away naturally by the sun. The fog is not created by the Adept, but summoned. Therefore, the Adept could not summon fog in an area or at a Hime where it would not normally be found (midafternoon on a sunny day in the desert, for example). The Base Chance for this spell is modified by the addition of the following numbers: If the terrain type is plain or waste -10 For each knot of wind in the area -1 If the terrain type is field, rough, or woods 5 If the terrain type is marsh or ocean 15 If the spell is cast during the night 20 If the spell is cast within 3 hours (before or after) of dawn 30

La nebbia è richiamata, non creata, quindi non si può ottenere dove o quando non si formerebbe normalmente (per esempio nel deserto a metà pomeriggio di una giornata di sole). Modificatori alla Base Chance: pianura o landa desolata -10; ogni nodo di vento -1; campi, terreno accidentato o bosco +5; palude o oceano +15; di notte +20; entro 3 ore (prima o dopo) dall'alba +30.

entries.name: Empath Spell
entries.effects: The Adept can feel the emotions and physical sensations currently experienced by the spell’s target. In addition, the Adept can absorb wounds from Endurance and Fatigue at the rate of 2 points cured for every 1 that the Adept agrees to subtract from his own Fatigue (never Endurance). Thus, an Adept could remove 6 Damage Points from a character by inflicting 3 Damage Points on himself.

Inoltre può assorbirne le ferite alla Resistenza e alla Fatica, curando 2 punti per ogni punto che accetta di togliere dalla propria Fatica (mai dalla Resistenza): per esempio può togliere 6 danni a un personaggio infliggendone 3 a se stesso.
